Ka sulat ne igpeendiye te

The letter sent to the

Hibruwanen

Hebrews

Igpewun-a

Introduction

Ka seini ne sulat, ware nanengnengi ke hentew ka migsulat kayi, piru igpeendiye seini te sabeka ne punduk te me Hudiyu ne migmalintutuu ne egngaranan degma te Hibruwanen. Insulat seini su eyew egkalig-en ka pegpalintutuu ran tenged su nana-nasian e ka keyirapan ne eg-antusen dan wey in-el-elehan ka pegpalintutuu ran ki Kristu. Sikan naa, imbagget sikandan te talagsulat meyitenged te pegpalintutuu ran wey impanulu din sikandan te si Hisu Kristu ka malehet wey ka katammanan ne impakita te Manama te me etew kayi te ampew te tane.

This letter, (it) is not known who wrote it, but this was_sent to a group of Hudiyu believers who are also called Hibruwanons. This was_written so_that their faith would_be_strengthened since the hardship that they suffered had increased and their faith in Christ was being tested. And so, they were encouraged by the writer concerning their faith and he taught them that Jesus Christ is the true and final revelation of God (MS Manama) to people here on earth (LIT on the top of the ground).

Ne due seini se tatelu ne kamalehetan ne mig-ay-ayaran din te egpanulu: (1) Si Hisus ka ware bunsuranan wey ware katamanan ne Anak te Manama. Ne labew pad sikandin te me prupita, me panalihan, wey minsan ki Muwisis. (2) Si Hisus ka impeila te Manama ne ware katamanan ne talagpanubad. Labew sikandin te me talagpanubad diye te Tapey ne Kasabutan. (3) Ne pinaahi ki Hisus, ka migpalintutuu kandin egkaluwas te sale wey te kamatayen.

Now there are three truths that he was careful to teach: 1/ Jesus is the Child of God without beginning and without end. And he is greater than the prophets, the angels, and even than Muwisis. 2/ Jesus is the (one) made_known by God as the eternal sacrificer. He is greater than the sacrificers in the Former Agreement. 3/ By means of Jesus, those who believe in him are_saved from sin and from death.

Nahuhud diye te kapitulu 11 ka meyitenged te pegpalintutuu te mabantug ne me Hibruwanen puun pad dengan. Sikan naa, imbagget te talagsulat ka migmalintutuu ne eglig-en te pegpalintutuu ran. Ne diye te kapitulu 12, imbagget din man-e sikandan ne egpabulus ka egmatinumanen taman te katamanan, ne iyan de egtengtengan si Hisus. Igpaantus man-e kandan ka me keyirapan wey ka pegbayad-bayad ne egginguma kandan. Piru keilangan ne egkatahaan dan ne seeye se langun, pegdisiplina re kandan te Manama isip me anak din. Mig-impusan din ka seini ne sulat pinaahi te pegtambag din wey pegpaney-paney rin.

It is told in chapter 11 concerning the faith of honored Hibruwanons from long_ago. And so, the writer encouraged the believers to strengthen their faith. And in chapter 12, he again encourages them to continue to be faithful until the end, and that Jesus is the only one they should look to. The hardships and the persecutions that will_happen to them will_ again _cause_ them _to_suffer. However (it is) necessary that they understand that all of that, is just God's disciplining of them as his offspring. He finished the letter by means of his encouragement(s) and warning(s).

Ka katelesan te Amey due te Anak

The splendor of the Father is in his Offspring

11 Dengan ne timpu, malasi migpakiglalag ka Manama te nalein-lein ne paahi diye te me kaap-apuan ta pinaahi te me prupita. 2 Piru te seini se katammanan ne timpu, migpakiglalag sikandin kanta pinaahi te Anak din ne in-alam din ne iyan egkeyimu ne kamuney te langun. Ne pinaahi kandin, inggimu te Manama ka kalibutan. 3 Due te Anak egkakita ka katelesan te Manama, wey ke nekey ka Manama, iling naan ded ka Anak. Sikandin ka egbuut wey egtanggu te langun pinaahi te maresen ne lalag din. Te napenga rin e ka inggimu rin ne peglinis te sale te me etew, migpinnuu e sikandin diye te igkakawanan[fn] te Amana ne Maresen ne Manama ne diye te langit.

11 A long time ago, God frequently spoke in various_kinds of ways to our(incl) ancestors by_means of the prophets. 2 But in this final time, he spoke to us(incl) by means of his Offspring whom he chose to be the (one) to become the owner of everything. By_means of him, God made the earth. 3 In the Offspring is seen the splendor of God, and whatever God is, the Offspring is just the same. He (is) the (one who) rules and cares for all by_means of his strong word. When he finished his work of cleaning the sins of the people, he sat_down at the right-side[fn] of the Very Strong God in heaven.

The Offspring is more great/prominent than angels

4 Purisu, labew pad sikandin te me panalihan te Manama wey labew pad degma ka genal ne imbehey te Manama kandin du te me panalihan. 5 [xra][xrb]Su ware de due panalihan ne migkahiyan te Manama,

wey matareng ka peg-uyan nu te migharian nu.

wey intekul te belad nu ka langit.

Ka pegpamalehet meyitenged te kaluwasan

The confirmation concerning salvation

21 Purisu, keilangan ne amanaan ta eg-ay-ayari te egpammineg ka kamalehetan ne narineg tad e eyew kene ki egpakasuwey due. 2 Ka Balaud ni Muwisis ne imbehey te Manama pinaahi te me panalihan, napamalehetan ne malehet iya, wey ka langun ne etew ne migsupak wey ware migtuman kayi, miglegparan e sumale te sale dan. 3 Purisu, egmenuwen te naa te egpakapanalliya te legpad ke egbalaharen ta seini se kaluwasan ne ware egkeilingan? Ka Magbebaye mismu ka an-anayan ne migpataha meyitenged te seini ne kaluwasan, wey impamalehet e degma seini kayi te kanta te seeye se nakarineg kandin. 4 Migpamalehet degma ka Manama meyitenged kayi pinaahi te me palinneu, me nalein-lein ne kein-inuwan, wey me katuenan ne imbehey te Panisingan te Manama sumale te pegbuut din.

21 Therefore, we(incl) need to listen more carefully to the truth that we(incl) have heard so_that we(incl) won't stray from it. 2 The Law of Muwisis that God gave by_means of angels, it was proved true, and all the people who denied and didn't obey it, (they) were punished according to their sin. 3 Therefore, how will we(incl) be_able_to_avoid punishment if we(incl) ignore this salvation that nothing compares_with? The Lord himself was first to make_known about this salvation, and it was also confirmed to us(incl) by those who had heard him. 4 God also confirmed about this by_means of signs, various amazing_things, and skills that the Spirit of God gave according to his will.

Ka pegginguma te kaluwasan pinaahi ki Hisus

Salvation came by_means of Jesus

5 Na, meyitenged te egkahiyen ney ne egginguma ne kalibutan, kene ne me panalihan te Manama ka egpeuyanen din due. 6 [xr]Piru due nasulat diye te Kasulatan ne miggenendue:

5 Now_then, concerning what we(excl) are saying of the world which will_come, it is not the angels of God whom he will_cause_to_govern it. 6 [xr]But there_is written in the Writings like_this:

“Manama, nekey bes ka etew, mania te egsumsumanen nu pad?

“God, what is man, why do you(sg) still think about (him)?

Mania te egtangguwen nu pad ka anak te etew?

Why do you(sg) still take_care of the child of man?

7 Impariralem nu sikandin te me panalihan te ware de naluhey.

7 You(sg) caused_ him _to_be_lower than the angels for just not long.

Ne imbehayan nu sikandin te katelesan wey bantug ne iling te Hari,

And you(sg) gave him splendor and honor like a king,

8 wey impabuut nu sikandin te langun.”

8 and you(sg) caused_ him _to_rule everything.”

Ne ka egkahiyen te Kasulatan ne “impabuut sikandin te langun,” iyan igpasabut due ne ware minsan nekey ne kene egbuutan te etew. Kuntee, ware te pad nakita ne neyimu seini se langun.9 Piru ke meyitenged ki Hisus, nakanengneng ki ne impariralem sikandin te Manama te me panalihan te ware de naluhey, su eyew pinaahi te keupiya wey keyid-u te Manama, egpatey sikandin para te langun ne etew. Ne imbehayan sikandin te katelesan wey bantug ne iling te Hari tenged te kamatayen ne in-antus din. 10 Inggimu te Manama ka langun wey ka langun ne inggimu rin para re iya kandin. Purisu, eleg de iya ne impaantus din ka migpuunan te kaluwasan ta ne si Hisus. Su pinaahi te peg-antus ni Hisus, nabayaan din ka langun ne keilangan ne egkabayaan din su eyew masalig ka anak te Manama ne egpakasawit te kabantug din.

And what the Writings say that “he was caused_to_rule everything,” what that means is that nothing whatsoever is not ruled by man. Today, we(incl) have not yet seen all of this happen.9 But if concerning Jesus, we(incl) understand that he was_made_lower than the angels by God for a short time (LIT not a long time), so_that by_means of the goodness and mercy of God, he will_die for all the people. And he was_given splendor and honor like a king as a result of the death that he suffered. 10 God made everything and everything he made was truly for him. Therefore, it is indeed right that he caused_ the source of our(incl) salvation who is Jesus _to_suffer. For by_means of Jesus' suffering, he (Jesus) experienced (LIT went past) all that was necessary for him to experience so_that many children of God will_be_able_to_expect to participate in God's greatness.

11 Ne si Hisus wey ka me etew ne immatulus din, sabeka re ka Amey ran. Ne tenged due, kene egkeyilew si Hisus ne egngaran kandan ne me suled din. 12 [xr]Su migkahi sikandin diye te Amey rin,

11 Now Jesus and the people whom he made_holy, they have just one Father. And as a result of that, Jesus is not ashamed to name them his siblings. 12 [xr]For he said to his Father,

“Ame, igpeila ku sikeykew te me suled ku;

“Dad, I will_make you(sg) known to my siblings;

wey egdayanen ku sikeykew diye te taliware te langun ne egsimba keykew.”

and I will_praise you(sg) in the center of all who worship you(sg).”

13 [xra][xrb]Migkahi degma sikandin, “Egsalig a iya te Manama.” Ne migkahi pad man-e sikandin, “Seini a duma te me anak ne imbehey te Manama keddi.”

13 [xra][xrb]He also said, “I will_ really _trust God.” And again he also said, “Here I am along_with the offspring whom God gave to me.”

14 Na, tenged su ka me anak te Manama etew re ne due sapu wey langesa, migpekeetew degma si Hisus ne iling ded kandan. Inggimu rin seini eyew pinaahi te kamatayen din, egdereetan din sika se due geem te kamatayen, ne iyan sika se ahalen te me busew. 15 Sikan naa, inluwas din ka langun ne neuripen seled te intiru ne umul ran tenged te pegkaaldek dan te kamatayen. 16 [xr]Su kene iya ne me panalihan ka egbulihan din, ke kene, ka me kabuhalan iya ni Abraham. 17 Purisu, keilangan ne neyimu iya sikandin ne iling te me suled din te minsan nekey ne paahi eyew egkeyimu sikandin ne hiid-uwen wey matinumanen ne Labew ne Talagpanubad te Manama, su eyew egpakabehey sikandin te igpanubad para te sale te me etew. 18 Sikan naa, puun su mig-antus wey intintal mismu si Hisus, egpakabulig sikandin te me etew ne egtintalen.

14 Now_then, since the offspring of God are only humans who have flesh and blood, Jesus also became_a_person like them. He did this so_that by_means of his death, he will_destroy the (one who) has the power of death, and that is the master of the evil_spirits. 15 And so, he saved all who were enslaved for their entire lives as a result of their fear of death. 16 [xr]For angels are not really the ones he helps, but rather, truly the descendants of Abraham. 17 Therefore, (it was) necessary that he really became like his siblings in whatever way so_that he will_become a merciful and faithful Great/Prominent Sacrificer of God, so_that he will_be_able_to_give a sacrifice for the sin(s) of the people. 18 And so, since Jesus himself suffered and was tempted, he is able_to_help people who are tempted.

Labew pad si Hisus ki Muwisis

Jesus is more prominent than Muwisis

31 Purisu me suled ku ne migmalintutuu ne in-alam te Manama ne keet-etawan din wey iling keddiey te in-umew te Manama ne egkeyimu ne duma rin diye te langit, sumsumana niyu si Hisus. Sikandin ka impeuyan te Manama wey ka Labew ne Talagpanubad te pegpalintutuu ta. 2 [xr]Matinumanen sikandin te Manama ne iyan mig-alam kandin, iling ki Muwisis te matinumanen ne mig-uyan te keet-etawan te Manama. 3 Piru si Hisus, in-isip ne subla pad ne mabantug ki Muwisis, su iling te sabeka ne etew ne egbebaley ne iyan mule egmabantug du te baley ne impasasindeg din. 4 Su ke due baley, due degma etew ne migpasasindeg due, piru ka Manama ka miggimu te langun. 5 Ne si Muwisis, matinumanen ne suluhuanen diye te keet-etawan te Manama. Ne ka inggimu rin, sabeka sika ne panunggilingan ke nekey ka igpataha keureme te Manama. 6 Piru si Kristu, ka Anak te Manama, ka matinumanen ne eg-uyan te keet-etawan te Manama. Ne sikanta ka keet-etawan din ke egpabulus ki iya ne egsalig wey egpeggasal ke nekey ka impallateng ta.

31 Therefore my believing siblings who were_chosen by God as his people and like me called by God to become his companion in heaven, you(pl) think about Jesus. He (is) the one sent by God and the Great/Prominent Sacrificer of our(incl) faith. 2 [xr]He is faithful to God who chose him, like Muwisis was faithful to govern the people of God. 3 But as for Jesus, (he) is considered to be more honored than Muwisis, because (it's) like a person who builds_a_house who instead is honored more than the house that he built (LIT caused_to_stand). 4 For if there_is a house, there_is also a person who built it, but God made everything. 5 And Muwisis, (he) was a faithful servant to the people of God. And his work, (it was) an example of what God will_make_known in_the_future. 6 But Christ, the Offspring of God, was faithful to govern the people of God. Now we(incl) (are) his people if we(incl) truly continue to trust and to boast in what we(incl) hope_for.

16 [xr]Hentew bes sikandan se nakarineg te laheng te Manama piru migsupak kandin? Seeye iya se nenakasale wey nammatey diye te disirtu. 18 Hentew bes ka impahunlibetan te Manama ne kene iya egpakaseled diye te himelayanan ne intahahe din kandan? Truly those who sinned and died in the desert. 18 To whom (emphasis) did God swear that (they) will_ truly not _be_able_to_enter into the resting_place which he prepared for them? Truly those who_rebelled_against him. 19 At that, we(incl) understand that they were_ not _able_to_enter into the resting_place because they did not believe the promise of God.

Ka himelayanan te keet-etawan te Manama

The resting_place for the people of God

41 Purisu, puun te duen pad ka saad te Manama ne egpakaseled ka me etew diye te himelayanan ne intahahe din, keilangan ne eg-ayad-ayad ki ne ware egkahaat kanta. 2 Su nakarineg kid e degma te Meupiya ne Panugtulen meyitenged te himelayanan iling te pegkarineg te me kaap-apuan ta dengan. Piru ware karuan seeye diye te kandan tenged su ware nikandan palintutuuwa ka inlalag te Manama. 3 [xr]Su sikanta re se migpalintutuu ka egpakaseled te himelayanan. Meyitenged te seeye se ware migpalintutuu, migkahi ka Manama,

41 Therefore, since the promise of God that the people will_be_able_to_enter into the resting_place which he prepared is still there, we(incl) need to be careful that none of us(incl) is left_behind. 2 For we(incl) have also heard the Good Report about the resting_place like our(incl) ancestors heard long_ago. But that was of no use to them because they didn't believe/obey what God said. 3 [xr]For only we(incl) who believe/obey will_be_able_to_enter the resting_place. Concerning those who did not believe/obey, God said,

“Migpahunlibet a te pegkalangeti ku ne, ‘Kene iya sikandan egpakaseled diye te himelayanan ne intahahe ku kandan!’ ”

“I swore in my anger that, ‘They will_ truly not _be_able_to_enter into the resting_place which I prepared for them!’ ”

Ingkahi rin seini minsan natahahe e ka seeye se himelayanan ligkat te inggimu rin ka kalibutan.4 [xr]Su due nasulat diye te Kasulatan meyitenged te igkapitu ne aldew ne miggenendue, “Te igkapitu ne aldew, miggimeley ka Manama su napenge e ka langun ne inggimu rin.” 5 [xr]Piru sumale te nasulat diye te ampew ne miggenendue, “Kene iya sikandan egpakaseled te himelayanan ne intahahe ku kandan!” 6 Sikan naa, due himelayanan ne egseleran perem te me etew. Piru sikandan se nakarineg dengan te Meupiya ne Panugtulen meyitenged te himelayanan, ware nakaseled tenged su ware sikandan migpalintutuu te Manama. 7 [xr]Ne mig-alam e man-e ka Manama te lein ne timpu te pegseled diye te himelayanan ne intahahe din, ne ka sika ne timpu egngaranan din, “Kuntee.” Su peglihad te me leg-un, migkahi ka Manama pinaahi ki Hari Dabid,

He said this even_though that resting_place has been_prepared since he made the world.4 [xr]For it is written in the Writings concerning the seventh day that goes_like_this, “On the seventh day, God rested because all of his work was_finished.” 5 [xr]But according to what was_written there above that goes_like_this, “They will_ truly not _be_able_to_enter into the resting_place which I prepared for them!” 6 And so, there_is a resting_place that could/should be_entered by people. But those who heard the Good Report long_ago concerning the resting_place, (they) were_ not _able_to_enter because they did not believe God. 7 [xr]And God again chose another time for entering into the resting_place which he prepared, and that time he named, “Today.” Because when years had passed, God said by_means of King Dabid,

“Emun ke egkarineg niyu kuntee ka laheng te Manama,

“If you(pl) hear the voice of God today,

kene niyu pakehala ka me ulu niyu.”

Don't(pl) harden your(pl) heads.”

8 [xr]Ne meyitenged te me etew dengan, ke diye pa uyana sikandan ni Huswi te himelayanan ne intahahe te Manama, warad e perem lalaha te Manama ka meyitenged te seeye se lein ne aldew ne egpakaseled ka me etew diye te himelayanan. 9 Purisu, duen pad peggimeley para te keet-etawan te Manama ne iling te peggimeley rin te igkapitu ne aldew. 10 [xr]Su minsan hentew ne egpakaseled te seeye ne himelayanan, egpekeyimeley degma te kandin ne himu iling te peggimeley te Manama dengan te peggimu rin te langun. 11 Purisu, egpakannekal ki ka egseled te seeye ne himelayanan su eyew ware sabeka kanta ne egpekeiling te me etew dengan ne migsupak te Manama ne ware nakaseled diye te himelayanan.

8 [xr]Now concerning the people long_ago, if Huswi had yet brought them to the resting_place which God prepared, God would no_longer have spoken about that different day that people will_be_able_to_enter the resting_place. 9 Therefore, there_is yet a rest for the people of God which is like his rest on the seventh day. 10 [xr]For whoever is able_to_enter that resting_place, (he) will_ also _be_able_to_rest from his work like the rest of God long_ago when he made everything. 11 Therefore, we(incl) will_strive to enter that resting_place so_that there are none among us(incl) who are_like the people long_ago who rebelled_against God and were_ not _able_to_enter the resting_place.

12 Su ka lalag te Manama, due geem wey manedted, ne subla pad ne mahalang du te sundang. Eg-uteng sika taman diye te kinariraleman te suman-suman wey te geyinawa, wey taman diye te utek te tul-an wey te buku-buku. Sika ka egpanengneng ke nekey ka suman-suman wey tuyu te etew. 13 Diye te tangkaan te Manama, warad iya igkeeles su ka langun egkakita rin wey egkamelmelehan din. Ne sikandin ka egpanabakan ta te langun ne eggimuwen ta.

12 For the word of God, (it) has power and is effective, and is sharper than a two-edged_sword. It cuts as far as the depths of the thoughts and spirit, and as far as the marrow (LIT brain of the bone) and joints. It is able_to_reveal what (are) the thought(s) and purpose of the person. 13 There in front of God, indeed nothing is hidden because he sees everything and sees_it_clearly. He (is) the one whom we(incl) will_answer to for everything that we(incl) do.

Si Hisus ka Labew ne Talagpanubad

Jesus is the Great/Prominent Sacrificer

14 Purisu, puun su due Labew ne Talagpanubad ta ne diyad e te langit, ne iyan si Hisus ne Anak te Manama, keilangan ne egdesdesenan ta ka pegpalintutuu ta. 15 Ne ka Labew ne Talagpanubad ta, egpakasabut te makasesale ki tenged te etew ki re, su intintal ma degma sikandin te langun ne igtintal kanta, piru ware mule sikandin nakasale. 16 Purisu keilangan ne kene ki egkeyilew ne egparani diye te tangkaan te hiid-uwen ne Manama su eyew igkeyid-u ki wey egbulihan ki nikandin te timpu te keyirapan ta.

14 Therefore, since we(incl) have a Great/Prominent Sacrificer who is already in heaven, who is Jesus the Offspring of God, we(incl) must hold_on_firmly to our(incl) faith. 15 And our(incl) Great/Prominent Sacrificer, (he) understands that we(incl) are sinners since we(incl) are only people, because he was_ also _tempted by everything that tempts us(incl), but he on_the_contrary did not sin. 16 Therefore (it is) necessary that we(incl) are_ not _ashamed to come_near to the presence (LIT front) of the merciful God so_that we(incl) will_be_shown_mercy and we(incl) will_be_helped by him in the time of our(incl) difficulty(s).

51 Na, ka Labew ne Talagpanubad te me Hudiyu, diye eg-alama te keet-etawan wey egsalihan sikandin ne eggendiye te tangkaan te Manama para te me duma ne me etew. Ne igbehey rin naa ka dasag dan wey ka igpanubad dan eyew egkapasaylu ka me sale dan. 2 Ne tenged su etew re degma sikandin ne makasesale, eg-ay-ayaran din seeye se egpakasuwey te kamalehetan wey ware nakanengneng ne mareet bes ka eggimuwen dan. 3 [xr]Ne tenged su egpakasale degma sikandin, keilangan ne egpanubad degma sikandin para te kandin mismu ne sale, ne kene de ne sale te duma ne me etew.

51 Now_then, the Great Sacrificer of the Hudiyus, (he) is chosen from the people and he is entrusted to go into the presence of God for the other people. And he gives their gift and their sacrifice(s) so_that their sins will_be_forgiven. 2 And since he is also just a human who is a sinner, he treats_carefully those who deviate from the truth and don't know that what they are_doing is bad. 3 [xr]And since he also sins, he must also sacrifice for his own sin, and not just for the sin of other people.

4 [xr]Ware etew ne egkeyimu ne Labew ne Talagpanubad tenged te kandin mismu ne igkeupii ne egkeyimu sikandin ne mabantug, ke kene, keilangan ne ka Manama ka eg-alam kandin iling te peg-alam din ki Aarun dengan. 5 [xr]Ne iling degma ki Kristu, su kene ne sikandin ka migpabantug te kandin ne pegkeetew ne eyew egkeyimu sikandin ne Labew ne Talagpanubad, ke kene, ka Manama ka mig-alam kandin. Su migkahiyan sikandin te Manama,

4 [xr]No person becomes a Great/Prominent Sacrificer as a result of his own desire to be honored, but rather, (it's) necessary that God chooses him like his choosing of Aarun long_ago. 5 [xr]Now Christ is also similar, because he was not the one to cause_ his reputation _to_be_honored in_order for him to become a Great/prominent Sacificer, but rather, God is the (one who) chose him. For God said to him,

“Anak ku sikeykew, ne kuntee, igpanengneng ku ne Amey ad e nikeykew.”

“You(sg) (are) my Offspring, and today, I will_cause_to_be_known that I (am) your(sg) Father.”

6 [xr]Ne due degma nasulat ne migkahi ka Manama,

6 [xr]And it is also written that God said,

“Talagpanubad ka te ware egtamanan, iling ki Milkisidik ne talagpanubad dengan.”

“You(sg) (are) a sacrificer forever (LIT without end), like Milkisidik the sacrificer long_ago.”

7 [xr]Te kayi pad si Hisus te ampew te tane, migpanaman-taman sikandin mig-ampu, migsinehew wey migpanguleyi te meemen ka egpeyid-u-hid-u diye te Manama ne iyan egpakapangabang kandin te kamatayen. Ne tenged te mapariralemen sikandin te Manama, narineg sikandin te Manama. 8 Ne minsan Anak sikandin te Manama, nateu sikandin ne egtuman te Manama pinaahi te peg-antus din. 9 Ne tenged su nabayaan din e ka keilangan ne egkabayaan din, neyimu e sikandin ne egpuunan te ware egtamanan ne kaluwasan te langun ne egtuman kandin. 10 Su inggimu sikandin te Manama ne Labew ne Talagpanubad iling ki Milkisidik.

7 [xr]When Jesus was still here on earth (LIT the top of the ground), he intensely prayed, cried and loudly shouted for mercy to God who is the one able_to_rescue him from death. And since he was submissive to God, he was_heard by God. 8 Now even_though he is the Offspring of God, he became_adept at obeying God by_means of his suffering. 9 And since he already experienced (LIT went past) what he needed to experience, he became the source of salvation without end for all who obey him. 10 Because God made him a Great/Prominent Sacrificer like Milkisidik.

Ka pegsapad meyitenged te peg-engked te pegpalintutuu

The warning concerning abandoning faith

11 Na, masalig pad perem ka iglalag ney kaniyu meyitenged kayi, piru malehen ne igpasabut kaniyu tenged su kene kew eglinga-linga. 12 [xr]Su minsan eleg kew e perem ne egpanulu, piru keilangan ne eg-abayan kew pad man-e egpanulua te lalag te Manama ne impanulu e kaniyu te an-anayan. Egpekeiling kew te egsusu pad ne me bate ne kene pad eleg ne egpakeenen te makehal ne keenen. 13 Su minsan hentew se gatas pad se eg-inumen, egpekeiling te bate ne ware katahaan ke nekey ka meupiya ne eggimuwen. 14 Piru ka makehal ne egkeenen, eleg te matesan e se pegpalintutuu. Sikandan ka migbebasbas ne egpekeila ke nekey ka meupiya wey mareet.

11 Now_then, there should be lots more for us(excl) to say to you(pl) about this, but (it's) difficult to cause_ you(pl) _to_understand because you(pl) are_ not _paying_attention. 12 [xr]For even_though you(pl) should already be fit to teach, nevertheless (it's) necessary for you(pl) to again be taught yet once_more the word of God that was taught you(pl) at the beginning. You(pl) are_like children who are still nursing who are not yet fit to be fed solid food. 13 For whoever still drinks milk, (they) are_like children who don't know what is good to do. 14 But solid food, (it is) fitting for (those) mature in faith. They (are) the ones who practice to be_able_to_recognize what is good and evil.

61 Purisu keilangan ne kene tad e eglibliberen ka an-anayan ne pegpanulu meyitenged ki Kristu su egpabulus kid e te maralem ne pegpanulu ne eleg te matesan e se pegpalintutuu. Kenad e ne keilangan ne egliberan te pad man-e igpanulu ka meyitenged te peg-inniyug te himu ne ware karuan wey ka meyitenged te pegpalintutuu te Manama. 2 Kene kid e man-e egpepanulu meyitenged te pegbewutismu, pegtel-eb te belad, pegkeuyag te me minatey, wey ka meyitenged te hukum te Manama kanta keureme ne kene egkabalbalawan te ware egtamanan. 3 Piru ke igtuhut te Manama, egpabulus kid e te maralem ne pegpanulu ne eleg te matesan e se pegpalintutuu.

61 Therefore we(incl) must not keep_returning_to the beginning teaching concerning Christ because we(incl) will_continue deep teaching that is fitting for those mature in faith. It's no_longer necessary for us(incl) to repeat again to teach about turning_away from acts that have_no use and about faith in God. 2 We(incl) will_ not _learn again about baptizing, placing_ hand(s) _on_top, coming_alive of corpses, or concerning God's judging of us(incl) in_the_future which will_ not _be_changed forever (LIT without end). 3 But if God permits, we(incl) will_continue deep teaching that is fitting for those mature in faith.

4 Su ke due etew ne eg-engked te pegpalintutuu rin ki Hisus, kene egkaayun ne eg-inniyug man-e sikandin te sale din. Su nakanengneng e sikandin te kamalehetan wey naheraman din e ka dasag te Manama, wey nakarawat e sikandin te Panisingan te Manama. 5 Naheraman din e ka keupiya te lalag te Manama wey ka geem te Manama ne amana ta egkaherami te egginguma ne timpu, 6 piru eg-engked ded sikandin te pegpalintutuu rin. Sikan naa, kenad e egkaayun ne egpaliberen pad sikandin egpeinniyuha te me sale din su egkeiling e te eg-abayan din pad man-e iglansang te krus ka Anak te Manama wey egpeyilawan diye te kasuluhan.

4 For if there_is a person who abandons his faith in Jesus, it's_ not _possible that he will_ again _turn_away from his sin. Because he already knows the truth and he has_ already _experienced the gift of God, and he already received the Spirit of God. 5 He has already experienced the goodness of the word of God and the power of God that we(incl) will_ greatly _experience in the coming time, 6 but he has just abandoned his faith. Therefore, it's_ not _possible that he will yet once_again be caused_to_turn_away from his sins because it's like he also once_again nails to the cross the Offspring of God and causes him to be shamed before many.

7 Na, sikanta se me etew, iyan ta egkeilingan ka tane. Emun ke malasi eg-urani ka tane ne egpakapatubu te meupiya ne pinamula wey egkapulusan te seeye se migpamula, impanalanginan naa te Manama ka sika ne tane. 8 [xr]Piru ke duhiyen de ne hilamunen ka igpatubu kayi, ware karuan te sika ne tane wey igdilus e te Manama, ne egkataman, egsilaban e.

7 Now_then, we(incl) people, what we(incl) are_like is the ground. If the ground is often rained_upon and is able_to_cause_to_sprout good plants and is valuable to the ones_who_plant, that ground was blessed by God. 8 [xr]But if only thorny weeds are caused_to_sprout here, that ground has no use and it will_be_cursed by God, and finally, burned_up.

9 Minsan iling due ka inlalag ney, me pinalangge ku ne me suled, piru nakamemalehet key ne meupiya pad dutu ka egkeulaula niyu tenged te me panalangin ne egpakaruma te kaluwasan niyu. 10 Su matareng ne talaggukum ka Manama. Kene din egkalingawan ka me himu niyu wey ka geyinawa ne impakita niyu kandin pinaahi te pegbulig niyu te keet-etawan din. Ne minsan kuntee, egpabulus kew pad ne egbulig kandan. 11 Ne iyan ney igkeupii ne egpabulus ka kaali-ali te tagse sabeka kaniyu ne eggimu te iling due taman te katamanan, eyew egkamalehet ka egpallatengen niyu. 12 Keilangan ne kene kew papepehul, ke kene, ilingi niyu seeye se nakarawat e te insaad te Manama tenged su migpabulus sikandan ne migpalintutuu wey ware sikandan napeleyi ne egtetahad.

9 Although what we(excl) have said is like this, my favored siblings, however we(excl) are certain that your(pl) fate will_be_better than that as a result of the blessings that accompany your(pl) salvation. 10 For God is a righteous judge. He will_ not _forget your(pl) works and the love that you(pl) showed him by means of your(pl) helping his people. And even today, you(pl) continue to_help them. 11 Now what we(excl) desire is that the diligence of each one of you(pl) to work like that until the end will_continue, so_that what you(pl) are hoping for will_come true. 12 (It's) necessary that you(pl) aren't lazy, but rather, you(pl) imitate those who received what God promised because they continued believing and they did not become_tired in waiting.

Egkatuman iya ka saad te Manama

The promise of God will_ surely _be_fulfilled

13 Sumsumana niyu ka timpu ne migsaad ka Manama ki Abraham. Ne puun su ware egpakalabew te Manama, ware sikandin migpahunlibet te duma ne ngaran eyew igpamalehet din ka insaad din, ke kene, ka kandin mismu ne ngaran ka impahunlibetan din. 14 [xr]Migkahi sikandin, “Egpanalanginan ku iya sikeykew wey egpabugbuhalen ka.” 15 Ne tenged su ware napeleyi si Abraham ne migtetahad, narawat din ka insaad te Manama. 16 Na, emun ke egpahunlibet ka sabeka ne etew, iyan din igpahunlibet ka labew pad kandin. Ne puun te seini ne pegpamalehet, egkewusey e ka me apulanan te me etew. 17 Iling ded degma ka inggimu te Manama te pegsaad din. Migpahunlibet sikandin te pegsaad din eyew igpakita rin te seeye se egpakarawat te insaad din, ne kene iya egkabalbalawan ka katuyuan din. 18 Ne ka daruwa ne inggimu te Manama, ka pegsaad din wey ka pegpahunlibet din, kene iya egkabalbalawan su kene egkaayun ne eg-uubat ka Manama. Purisu sikanta se nakaaput e te Manama, egkabagget ki ne kene egleke te impallateng ta ne me panalangin ne insaad din kanta. 19 [xr]Ka seini ne pegpallateng, ka egpekeehet te pegpalintutuu ta,[fn] tenged su klaru iya ne egkarawat ta ka insaad te Manama kanta. Tenged te pegpallateng ta, hendue te nakaseled kid e diye te ugpaan te Manama iling te pegseled te Labew ne Talagpanubad diye te matulus ne sinabeng ne in-eletan te makepal ne kurtina. 20 [xr]Ne miggun-e e si Hisus diye te langit eyew egpangatubang para kanta su neyimu sikandin ne Labew ne Talagpanubad te ware egtamanan, iling ki Milkisidik ne talagpanubad dengan.

13 Think(pl) about the time that God promised Abraham. And since there_was_no one more great/prominent than God, he did not swear by another name in_order to confirm his promise, but rather, his own name was what he swore by. 14 [xr]He said, “I will_ truly _bless you(sg) and cause_ you(sg) _to_produce_many_descendants.” 15 And since Abraham did not become_tired in waiting, he received what God promised. 16 Now_then, if/when a person swears, the one he swears_by is more great/prominent than him. And from this confirmation, people's disputes are resolved. 17 God's making of his promise was also similar. He swore when he promised in_order for him to show to those who are able_to_receive what he promised, that his purpose would indeed not change. 18 Now the two (things) that God did, his promising and his swearing, (they) will_ indeed not _be_changed because it's_ not _possible for God to lie. Therefore we(incl) who have taken_refuge in God, (we) will_be_encouraged not to release our(incl) hope of blessings that he promised us(incl). 19 [xr]This hope, is able_to_make_tight our(incl) faith,[fn] because it is clear that we(incl) will_receive the promise of God to us(incl). As a result of our(incl) faith, it's like we(incl) are able_to_enter into the living_place of God like the entrance of the prominent/great sacrificer into the holy room that was blocked by a thick curtain. 20 [xr]And Jesus went first/ahead to heaven in_order to make_an_appeal for us(incl) for he became the Great/Prominent Sacrificer forever, like Milkisidik who was the sacrificer long_ago.

Ka talagpanubad ne si Milkisidik

The sacrificer Milkisidik

71 [xr]Ne si Milkisidik ka Hari dengan diye te Salim wey ka talagpanubad degma te Amana ne Mabantug ne Manama. Sikandin ka migsinug-ung te peg-uli ni Abraham te migbubunu ne nakapanalu te me Hari, wey ka migpanalangin kandin. 2 Ne imbehey ni Abraham ki Milkisidik ka igkasapulu ne baad te langun ne naawi din te pegbubunu. Ka kaluwasan te ngaran ne Milkisidik, “matareng ne Hari.” Ne tenged su iyan kaluwasan te inged ne Salim ne migharian din ka “keupianan,” egngaranan ded man-e sikandin te “Hari te keupianan.” 3 Ware nasulat ka meyitenged te amey rin, iney rin, wey me kaap-apuan din. Ware degma nasulat ka meyitenged te peglesut din wey ka pegpatey rin. Iling sikandin te Anak te Manama ne ware bunsuranan wey ware katammanan tenged su egpabulus sikandin ne talagpanubad te ware egtamanan.

71 [xr]Now Milkisidik was a king in Salim long_ago and also the sacrificer of the Very Great/Famous/Honorable God. He (was) the (one who) met Abraham_returning_home from fighting/warring where he was_able_to_defeat the kings, and the (one who) blessed him. 2 And Abraham gave Milkisidik a tenth portion of all that he retrieved from warring. The meaning of the name of Milkisidik, (is) “righteous King.” And since the meaning of the place Salim where he reigned_as_king was “peace/well-being,” he was also named the “King of peace/well-being.” 3 There was nothing written about his father, his mother, or his ancestors. There was also nothing written about his birth or his death. He is like the Offspring of God without beginning and without end for he continues a sacrificer forever (LIT without end).

4 Ne sumsumana niyu kamenu kabantug si Milkisidik. Su minsan mabantug ka kaap-apuan ta ne si Abraham, migbehey ma kandin te igkasapulu ne baad te langun ne naawi din te pegbubunu. 5 [xr]Ne sumale te Balaud ni Muwisis, insuhu ka me talagpanubad ne kabuhalan ni Libi ne iyan egpanguwa te igkasapulu ne baad puun te me duma ran ne me Hudiyu, minsan kabuhalan sikandan langun ni Abraham. 6 Piru si Milkisidik, minsan kene ne kabuhalan ni Libi, nakarawat sikandin te igkasapulu puun ki Abraham, wey sikandin ka migpanalangin ki Abraham, minsan si Abraham mule ka migsaaran te Manama. 7 Ne nakataha ka langun ne iyan subla ne labew ka migpanalangin du te seeye se impanalanginan. 8 Ne meyitenged te me talagpanubad ne kabuhalan ni Libi ne iyan egdawat te igkasapulu ne baad, me etew re sikandan ne egpamatey. Piru sumale te Kasulatan, hendue te ware mule migpatey si Milkisidik ka migdawat te igkasapulu ne baad. 9 Egpakakahi ki te minsan si Libi, ne iyan egdawat te igkasapulu, migbehey red degma te igkasapulu diye te ki Milkisidik pinaahi ki Abraham. 10 Su minsan ware pad neetew si Libi te pegsinug-ung ni Milkisidik ki Abraham, piru duen e sikandin te lawa te kaapuan din ne si Abraham.

4 Now you(pl) think about how great/famous/honored Milkisidik is. For even our(incl) great/famous/honored ancestor Abraham, (he) gave him a tenth portion of all that he retrieved from warring. 5 [xr]And according to the Law of Muwisis, the sacrificers who were descendants of Libi were commanded that they were the ones to get the tenth portion from their companion Hudiyus, even_though they were all descendants of Abraham. 6 But Milkisidik, although not a descendant of Libi, he received the tenth from Abraham, and he was the one_who_blessed Abraham, even_though Abraham on_the_contrary was the one_promised_to by God. 7 And everyone knows that the (one who) blesses is more great/prominent than that one who is blessed. 8 And concerning sacrificers who are descendants of Libi who (are) the ones to receive the tenth portion, they are only humans who die. But according to the Writings, (it's) as_if in_contrast Milkisidik who received the tenth portion didn't die. 9 We(incl) can say that even Libi, who is the one to receive the tenth, (he) also gave the tenth to Milkisidik by_means of Abraham. 10 For although Libi had_ not yet _been_born (LIT become_a_person) at the meeting of Milkisidik with Abraham, yet he was already there in the body of his ancestor Abraham.

Labew si Hisus te duma ne talagpanubad

Jesus is high/prominent to other sacrificers

11 Na, emun ke namatareng e perem ka me Hudiyu pinaahi te himu te me talagpanubad ne kabuhalan ni Libi ne iyan mig-uyan te Balaud diye te kandan, kenad e perem keilangan ne duen pad lein ne talagpanubad. Piru duen en iya lein ne talagpanubad ne egpekeiling ki Milkisidik, ne kene mule ne iling ki Aarun ne kabuhalan ni Libi. 12 Ne emun ke egkabullasan ka me talagpanubad te kenad e ne kabuhalan ni Libi, keilangan degma ne egkabullasan ka Balaud. 13-14 Ka malehet due, ka Magbebaye ta ne egkahiyen ku kayi, kene ne kabuhalan ni Libi, su ki Huda. Ne ka me kabuhalan ni Huda, warad iya nahuhud ni Muwisis dengan ne diye egpuun te sika ne tribu ka egkeyimu ne talagpanubad.

11 Now_then, if the Hudiyus had become_righteous by means of the work of the sacrificers who were descendants of Libi who (are) the ones that administered the Law to them, (it) would no_longer be necessary to have yet another/a_different sacrificer. But there_is indeed another/a_different sacrificer like Milkisidik, who is unlike Aarun who was a descendant of Libi. 12 And if the sacrificers are replaced by (one who is) no_longer a descendant of Libi, (it's) also necessary to replace the Law. 13-14 The truth of it (is), our(incl) Lord of whom I am_speaking here, (he) is not a descendant of Libi, because (he is a descendant) of Huda. 15 Ne amana naklaru seini se ingkahi ney su due lein ne talagpanubad ne migginguma ne nekeiling ki Milkisidik. 16 Ware sikandin neyimu ne talagpanubad sumale te Balaud ne iyan de egkeyimu ne talagpanubad ka kabuhalan ni Libi, ke kene, pinaahi te geem te umul rin ne kene egkataman. 17 [xr]Su nasulat diye te Kasulatan ka meyitenged kandin, “Talagpanubad ka te ware egtamanan iling ki Milkisidik ne talagpanubad dengan.” 18 Purisu indapig e te Manama ka sika se tapey ne balaud tenged su ware karuan due. 19 Su kene ki egkeyimu ne matareng pinaahi te pegtuman te Balaud. Piru imbehayan ki te Manama te iyam ne paahi, ne pinaahi rue egpakaparani kid e kandin.

15 And this that we(excl) have said is very clear for there_is another sacrificer who arrived who is like Milkisidik. 16 He did not become a sacrificer according to the Law that the only ones to become sacrificers (are) the descendants of Libi, but rather, by_means of the power of his life without end. 17 [xr]For it is written in the Writings concerning him, “You(sg) (are) a sacrificer without end like Milkisidik the sacrificer long_ago.” 18 Therefore God has put_aside that former law because it is useless. 19 For we(incl) can't become righteous by_means of obeying the Law. 20 Ne kene ne sikan de su due degma saad te Manama eyew egkapamalehetan ka seeye se iyam ne paahi. 20 And not only that because there_is also a promise of God in_order_to confirm that new way. “Migsaad ka Magbebaye ne Manama ne,

“The Lord God promised that,

‘Talagpanubad ka te ware egtamanan,’

‘You(sg) (are) a sacrificer without end,’

wey kene egkabalbalawan ka suman-suman din.”

22 Purisu, tenged te sika ne saad, neyimu si Hisus ne kasihuruwan te iyam ne kasabutan ne subla pad ne meupiya.

22 Therefore, as a result of that promise, Jesus became the assurance of a new agreement that is much better.

23 Ne timul pad due, masulug ka me talagpanubad dengan su emun ke egpatey ka sabeka, keilangan ne egliwanan sikandin su eyew ka himu te me talagpanubad, egpakapabulus. 24 Piru puun su egkeuyag mule si Hisus te ware egtamanan, kene egliwanan sikandin isip talagpanubad. 25 Purisu, egpakaluwas sikandin te ware egtamanan te seeye se egparani te Manama pinaahi kandin. Su egkeuyag sikandin te ware egtamanan eyew iyan egpataliware te Manama wey te me etew.

23 And in addition to that, there were many sacrificers long_ago for if one died, (it was) necessary that he be replaced so_that the work of sacrificers, (it) would_be_able_to_continue. 24 But since Jesus in_contrast is alive forever, he will_ not _be_replaced as a sacrificer. 25 Therefore, he is able_to_save forever those who come_close to God by_means of him. 26 Ne sikandin ka Labew ne Talagpanubad ne ingkeilangan ta. Su matulus sikandin, ne ware sale wey malinis. Kene ne iling sikandin te makasesale, wey imbatun e sikandin diye te langit. 27 [xr]Kene ne keilangan ne egpanubad si Hisus tagse aldew iling te duma ne labew ne me talagpanubad. Miggun-aan dan himuwa seini para te kandan mismu ne sale, ne igkarangeb, para te sale te duma ne me etew. Piru si Hisus, kasabeka rin de mule ipanubad ka pegkeetew rin para te sale te me etew. 28 Ka in-alam ne labew ne me talagpanubad sumale te Balaud ni Muwisis, me etew re degma sikandan ne mahuye. Piru sumale te saad te Manama ne inggimu rin te pegkapenga rin ibehey ka Balaud, in-alam din ka Anak din ne ware seyyup ne egkeyimu ne talagpanubad te ware egtamanan.

26 And he is the Great/Prominent Sacrificer whom we(incl) need. For he is holy, without sin and clean. He is not like sinners, and he was_taken_up to heaven. 27 [xr](It's) not necessary for Jesus to sacrifice every day like the other great/prominent sacrificers.
