Si Hisus ka Labew ne Talagpanubad ta

Jesus is our(incl) Great/Prominent Sacrificer

81 [xr]Na, seini ka igpasabut te ingkahi ney kaniyu: duen e Labew ne Talagpanubad ta ne diyad e te langit, ne diye migpinnuu sikandin te igkakawanan[fn] te trunu te Amana ne Maresen ne Manama. 2 Egpamakey sikandin isip Labew ne Talagpanubad diye te matulus ne ugpaan te Manama ne diye te langit ne malehet ne simbaan su kene ne impasasindeg te me etew, ke kene, inggimu mule te Manama. 3 Ne tenged su keilangan ne egbehey te dasag wey te igpanubad diye te Manama ka tagse labew ne talagpanubad, keilangan ne due degma igpanubad te kanta ne Labew ne Talagpanubad. 4 Emun ke kayi sikandin te ampew te tane, kene ne talagpanubad sikandin, su duen e me talagpanubad ne egpanubad sumale te Balaud ni Muwisis. 5 [xr]Ka impamakayan dan ne matulus ne balungbalung, in-ilingan de sika wey alung de te ugpaan te Manama ne diye te langit. Su, te timpu ne igpes-ek e ni Muwisis sika, impanpanayan e sikandin te Manama te migkahi, “Keilangan ne eggimuwen nu ka langun iling te impakita ku keykew diye te bubungan.” 6 Piru ka himu ni Hisus, subla pad ne meupiya du te himu te seeye se duma ne talagpanubad puun su ka iyam ne kasabutan ne impataliwaraan din, subla pad ne meupiya du te tapey ne kasabutan. Iyan nakameupiya te iyam ne kasabutan, su diye sika egligkat te subla pad ne meupiya ne me saad.

81 [xr]Now_then, this is the meaning of what we(excl) have said to you(pl): we(incl) already have a Great/prominent Sacrificer who is already in heaven, and there he sits at the right-side[fn] of the throne of Very Strong God. 2 He serves as the Great/Prominent Sacrificer there in the holy living of God which is in heaven and is the true worship_place because it was not built (LIT caused_to_stand) by people, but rather, made instead by God. 3 Now since (it's) necessary that every great/prominent sacrificer gives gifts and sacrifices to God, (it's) necessary that there_is also a sacrifice by our(incl) Great/Prominent Sacrificer. 4 If he was still here on earth (LIT on the top of the ground), he would not be a sacrificer, for there are already sacrificers who sacrifice according to the Law of Muwisis. 5 [xr]Their place_of_service which is a holy tent, it was just a copy and just a shadow/reflection of the living_place of God in heaven. Because, at the time that Muwisis erected (LIT put_in_the_posts) it, he was warned by God saying, “You(sg) need to make everything like what_ I _showed you(sg) on the mountain.” 6 But the work of Jesus, (it is) much better than the work of those other sacrificers because the new agreement which he mediates (LIT goes_in_between), (it) is much better than the old agreement. What was_able_to_make the new agreement better, (was) because it comes_from much better promises.

7 Su ke ware pad perem kulang te seeye se an-anayan ne kasabutan, kenad perem keilangan ne egliwanan te igkarangeb ne kasabutan. 8 [xr]Piru nakita te Manama ne nakulangan ka me etew ne mig-ikul perem te an-anayan ne kasabutan. Purisu migkahi sikandin,

7 For if there would have_been nothing lacking in that first agreement, it would never be necessary to replace (it) with a second agreement. 8 [xr]But God saw that the people who tried to follow the first agreement were lacking. Therefore he said,

“Egginguma ka timpu, kahi te Magbebaye ne Manama, ne eggimuwen ku ka iyam ne kasabutan diye te me kabuhalan ni Israil wey diye te me kabuhalan ni Huda.

“The time will_arrive, says the Lord God, when I will_make a new agreement with the descendants of Israil and with the descendants of Huda.

9 Ne seini, kene ne iling te kasabutan ne inggimu ku diye te me kaap-apuan dan te ingkitkit ku sikandan te peg-awe dan diye te inged ne Ihiptu.

9 And this, (it's) not like the agreement that I made with their ancestors when I led_ them _by_the_hand when they departed from the place of Ihiptu.

Ware dan tumana ka sika ne kasabutan,

They did not obey that agreement,

purisu imbalahad ku sikandan, kahi te Magbebaye ne Manama.

therefore I ignored them, says the Lord God.

10 Piru ke egginguma ka sika ne timpu, seini ka iyam ne kasabutan ne eggimuwen ku diye te kabuhalan ni Israil, kahi te Magbebaye ne Manama: igtahu ku ka me balaud ku diye te suman-suman dan, wey igsulat ku seini diye te pusung dan.

10 But when that time comes, this is the new agreement that I will_make with the descendants of Israil, says the Lord God: I will_put my laws in their minds, and I will_write this on their hearts.

Manama ad nikandan, wey keet-etawan kud e degma sikandan.

I will_be_God to them, and they will_ also _be my people.

11 Te sika ne timpu, kenad e ne keilangan ne egpanulu ka sabeka ne etew te me duma rin wey ke me suled din te keilangan ne egpekeila sikandan te Manama.

11 At that time, (it) will_ no_longer _be_necessary for a person to teach his companions or his siblings that (it's) necessary that they know God.

Su sikandan langun, egpekeila keddiey ligkat te kene ne impurtanti ne etew peendiye te subla ne mabantug.

For all of them, (they) will_know me from the least/not important person to the very great/famous/honored.

12 Su egpasayluwen ku sikandan te mareet ne me himu ran, wey kene kud e egsumsumanen ka me sale dan.”

12 For I will_forgive them for their wicked deeds, and I will_ no_longer _think about their sins.”

13 Ne tenged te ingngaranan te Manama te “iyam” ka seini ne kasabutan, klaru e ne tapey e ka an-anayan ne kasabutan. Ne sika, kenad e egkahamit wey kene egkaluhey, egkaawe e.

13 Now since God named this agreement “new”, (it's) clear that the first agreement is already old/former. And that, (it) will_ no_longer _be_used and in a short time (LIT not a long time), (it) will_disappear.

Ka pegsimba te timpu te an-anayan ne kasabutan

Worship at the time of the first agreement

91 Na, minsan ka an-anayan ne kasabutan, due me balaud meyitenged te pegsimba te Manama. Ne due degma matulus ne balungbalung ne inggimu ran kayi te ampew te tane eyew egsimbaan. 2 [xra][xrb][xrc]Seeye se balungbalung, due daruwa ne sinabeng. Ka an-anayan ne sinabeng, egngaranan te “Matulus ne Sinabeng.” Ne dutu nakatahu ka tahuanan te sulu, ka lamisa, wey ka me paan ne igpanubad diye te Manama. 3 [xr]Ka igkarangeb ne sinabeng ne diye te limang te makepal ne kurtina, egngaranan te “Amana ne Matulus ne Sinabeng.” 4 [xra][xrb][xrc][xrd][xre]Te sika ne sinabeng, diye ipanahu ka bulawan ne altar ne tutunganan te insinsu wey ka kaban te kasabutan ne imbulitan te bulawan. Ne diye naa degma itahu te kaban ka banga ne bulawan ne intahuan te egkeenen ne egngaranan te “mana”, ka migpangabukad ne tuked ni Aarun, wey ka daruwa ne malumpayag ne batu ne insulatan te Sapulu ne Suhu. 5 [xr]Ne diye te supe te kaban, due inggimu re te etew ne daruwa ne panalihan ne egngaranan te kirubin[fn] ne palinneu te due ka Manama. Migpatangkeey sikandan ne impamekal ka me pakpak dan diye te dibabew te supe te kaban. Ne diye naa te natel-eban te me pakpak egpasayluwa te Manama ka me sale te me etew. Piru kene ney pad igpakapasabut kuntee kaniyu seini se langun.

91 Now_then, even the first agreement, (it) had laws concerning the worship of God. And (it) also had a holy tent that they made here on earth for a worship_place. 2 [xra][xrb][xrc]That tent, it had two rooms. The first room, (it) was_named “The Holy Room.” And there_was placed the lamp, the table, and the bread that was sacrificed/offered to God. 3 [xr]The second room on the other_side of the thick curtain, (it) was called the “Very Holy Room.” 4 [xra][xrb][xrc][xrd][xre]In that room, there_was placed the golden altar which was the burning_place of incense and the chest of the agreement that was_covered with gold. And also placed in the chest were the golden jar that contained the food called “manna”, the staff of Aarun that had blossomed, and the two flat stones written_with the Ten Commands. 5 [xr]And on the lid of the chest, there were two man-made (LIT just made by people) angels called kirubin[fn] which were a sign that God was there. They faced_one_another and their wings flared_out above the lid of the chest. And there in the place_covered by their wings God forgives the sins of the people. But we(excl) are_ not _able_to_cause_ you(pl) _to_understand all of this now.

6 [xr]Te nateil e seeye se langun, henduen pad ne nakaseled ka me talagpanubad te tagse aldew diye te an-anayan ne sinabeng eyew te peggimu te katungdanan dan. 7 [xr]Piru iyan de egpakaseled ka labew ne talagpanubad diye te igkarangeb ne sinabeng, wey kasabeka re egpakaseled sikandin te tagse leg-un. Te sika ne timpu, keilangan ne eg-uyanen din ka langesa te ayam ne igpanubad din diye te Manama para te sale din wey te sale te me etew ne ware dan nataheyi. 8 Pinaahi te seini se langun, migpanulu ka Panisingan te Manama ne kene egpakaparani ka me etew diye te tangkaan te Manama taheed te eg-ikul pad sikandan te me suhu diye te an-anayan ne kasabutan.[fn] 9 Ka sika langun, panunggilingan de te seeye ne timpu. Su ka igpanubad wey ka igbehey diye te Manama, kene egpakalinis te kunsinsya te egmanimba. 10 Su meyitenged de seeye te egkakeen, inumen, wey te nalein-lein ne peglinis te lawa. Meyitenged de te lawa ka sika ne me balaud wey egkataman de te timpu te iyam ne kasabutan.

6 [xr]When/if all that was arranged, only then did the sacrificers enter each day into the first room in_order to do their responsibilities. 7 [xr]But only the great/prominent sacrificer is able_to_enter the second room, and he is only able_to_enter (it) once every year. At that time, (it is) necessary that he bring blood of livestock that he will_offer/sacrifice to God for his sin and the sin of the people that they don't know_about. 8 By means of this all, the Spirit of God taught that the people can't approach the front of God as_long_as they follow the commands from the first agreement.[fn] 9 All of that, (it is) just an example for that time. Because what is sacrificed and what is given to God, (it) can't clean the conscience of those_who_worship. 10 Because those only concerned food, drink, and various cleaning of the body. Those laws only concerned the body and were just until the time of the new agreement.

Ka langesa ni Kristu ka nakapamalehet te iyam ne kasabutan

The blood of Christ confirms new agreement

11 Piru miggingume e si Kristu ka Labew ne Talagpanubad te iyam ne kasabutan ne subla pad ne meupiya du te tapey. Nakaseled sikandin te subla pad ne meupiya wey subla pad ne matulus ne ugpaan ne ware himuwa te etew su kene ma ne kayi te ampew te tane. 12 Pegseled ni Kristu diye te matulus ne ugpaan ne diye te langit, kene ne langesa te me kambing wey ke nati te baka ka in-uyan din su ka kandin mismu ne langesa pinaahi te kamatayen din, ne puun due, nakuwa rin ka kaluwasan ta ne ware egtamanan. Ne kasabeka re sikandin migseled diye wey warad e mig-abey. 13 [xra][xrb]Sumale te tapey ne kasabutan, emun ke due etew ne in-isip ne malindit su nakasamsam te minatey, keilangan ne egpabesikan te langesa te kambing wey ke turu ne baka wey te igmuk te intutung ne beyan ne baka eyew egkeyimu ne malinis ka lawa rin diye te tangkaan te Manama. 14 Ke egpakalinis ma te iling due ka langesa te me mananap, subla pad ka langesa ni Kristu! Su pinaahi te geem te ware egtamanan ne Panisingan te Manama, impanubad ni Kristu diye te Manama ka pegkeetew rin ne ware sale. Ka langesa rin ka egpakalinis te kunsinsya ta ne egligkat te himu ne iyan egpuunan ne egpakapariyu ki te Manama. Eglinisan din sika su eyew egpakapamakey ki te manekal ne Manama.

11 But Christ the Great/Prominent Sacrificer of the new agreement which is much better than the former has arrived. He entered the much better and more holy living_place that was not made by a person for it is not here on the earth (LIT top of the ground). 12 When Christ entered the holy living_place that is in heaven, it wasn't the blood of goats or of calves of cows that he brought because it was his own blood by_means of his death, and from that, he obtained our(incl) never ending salvation. And he only entered once and never repeated (it). 13 [xra][xrb]According to the former agreement, if there_is a person who is thought of as dirty because he touched a corpse, (he) needs to be splattered with goat or bull blood and with ashes of a burnt female cow so_that his body will_become clean in front of God. 14 If the blood of animals can clean like that, much more the blood of Christ! Because through the powerful and never ending Spirit of God, Christ sacrificed his sinless self to God. His blood is_able_to_clean our(incl) conscience(s) from the deed(s) that (are) the reason that we(incl) distance_(ourselves) from God. He cleans it so_that we(incl) can_serve the strong/living God.

15 Purisu, si Kristu ka tigpataliware te me etew wey te Manama te iyam ne kasabutan. Su pinaahi te kamatayen din, nalekat din e ka me etew puun te me sale dan ne neyimu ran te an-anayan ne kasabutan. Inggimu rin sika su eyew seeye se in-alam te Manama, egpakarawat te insaad din ne keupianan ne ware egtamanan.

15 Therefore, Christ is the mediator of the new agreement between people and God. For by means of his death, he has redeemed people from their sins that they did in the first agreement. He did that so_that those whom God chose, (they are) able_to_receive eternal peace/well-being that was promised by him.

16 Na, ke due migpeyimu te kasabutan, keilangan ne igpapitew ka eggimatayan ne igpanubad eyew egkapamalehetan ka kasabutan. 17 Su ka kasabutan, wey re egkapamaleheti ke due egkeyimatayan, ne ware karuan due ke ware pad neyimatayi ka igpanubad. 18 Purisu minsan seeye se an-anayan ne kasabutan, ware perem napamaleheti ke ware langesa ne impatihis. 19 [xr]Su pegkapenga inangen ni Muwisis ka intiru ne Balaud diye te langun ne etew, ingkuwa rin e ka langesa te nati te baka wey te kambing duma te weyig. Impabesikan din ka insulatan te me balaud duma te langun ne etew ne iyan inggamit ka sugpang te kayu ne isupu wey ka intinaan te malalab-lalab ne bulbul te karniru. 20 Ne migkahi sikandin, “Seini ka langesa ne igpamalehet te kasabutan ne igpatuman te Manama kaniyu.” 21 [xr]Ne impabesbesikan din degma ka matulus ne balungbalung wey ka langun ne tahu ne egkahamit te pegpanubad te Manama. 22 [xr]Sumale te Balaud ni Muwisis, ka langun, bayew iya egkalinisi te langesa. Ne wey re egkapasaylu ka me sale ke igpatihis ka langesa te igpanubad.

16 Now_then, if someone causes_ an agreement _to_be_made, it's_necessary to show the sacrifice that's killed in_order to confirm/prove the agreement. 17 Because the agreement, can only be confirmed/proven if something is killed, and there's_no point to it if the sacrifice isn't yet killed. 18 Therefore even that first agreement, it would not have_been_confirmed if there_was_no blood spilled. 19 [xr]Because after Muwisis informed all the people (about) the entire Law, he took the blood of a calf of a cow and a goat along_with water. He splattered what_ the laws _were_written_on along_with all the people using a branch of a hyssop tree and sheep hair dyed very_red. 20 And he said, “This is the blood that confirms the agreement that God will_cause_ you(pl) _to_fulfill.” 21 [xr]And he also splattered the holy tent and all the contents that were used for sacrificing to God. 22 [xr]According to the Law of Muwisis, everything, really almost (everything) is_cleaned with blood. And sins will_ only _be_forgiven if blood is spilled from a sacrifice.

23 Purisu, keilangan ne egkalinisan seeye se impeiling de te ugpaan diye te langit pinaahi te pegpabesik-besik te langesa te ayam. Piru ka malehet ne ugpaan te Manama diye te langit, keilangan ne subla pad ne meupiya ka igpanubad du te langesa te ayam. 24 Su ware migseled si Kristu diye te matulus ne balungbalung ne impeiling de te malehet ne ugpaan te Manama wey inggimu re te etew, ke kene, ka langit mismu ka inseleran din. Ne diyad e kuntee sikandin te tangkaan te Manama eyew egpangatubang para kanta. 25 Ka labew ne talagpanubad te me Hudiyu, migseled diye te Subla ne Matulus ne Sinabeng te tagse leg-un ne mig-uyan te langesa te ayam. Piru si Kristu mule, kene ne iyan din inseled diye te langit ne eyew layun din igpanubad ka kandin ne lawa. 26 Su ke iling ma rue, keilangan ne layun perem sikandin egpatey puun te peggimu te kalibutan. Piru te timpu ne napenge e ka an-anayan ne kasabutan, kasabeka re sikandin miggendini eyew te peg-awe te sale ta pinaahi te pegpanubad din te kandin ne lawa wey kene din e eg-abayan eggimuwa seini. 27 Ka me etew, kasabeka re iya egpatey wey egkataman eggukuman e sikandan te Manama. 28 [xr]Ne iling naan ded degma, migpatey si Kristu te kasabeka re eyew te peg-awe te me sale te me etew. Ne eggendini man-e sikandin ne kenad en iyan din tuyu ka peg-awe te me sale, ke kene, ka pegluwas te seeye se mabagget ne egtetahad te peglibed din.

23 Therefore, (it is) necessary that that which is just a copy of the living_place in heaven is_cleaned by means of splattering with the blood of livestock. But the true living_place of God in heaven, (it) needs a better sacrifice than the blood of livestock. 24 For Christ did_ not _enter a holy tent that was just a copy of the true living of God and which was_ just _made by people, but rather, heaven itself was what_ he _entered. And he is there today in the presence of God in_order to make_an_appeal (LIT stand_before) for us(incl). 25 The great/prominent sacrificer of the Hudiyus, (he) entered the Very Holy Room every year bringing the blood of livestock. But Christ on the other hand, the reason he entered heaven was not in_order to sacrifice his body often. 26 For if it's like that, (it) would_be_necessary that he would have often died since the creation of the world. But at the time that the first agreement was_finished, he came_here just once in_order_to remove our(incl) sin by means of his sacrificing his body and he will_ not _repeat doing this. 27 People, (they) indeed only die once and afterwards they are judged by God. 28 [xr]Now just like that also, Christ died only once in_order to remove sins of people. And he will_come again and no_longer will his purpose be the removing of sins, but rather, the saving of those who are anticipating and waiting for his return.

Ka kamatayen ni Kristu ka egpakaawe te sale

The death of Christ is what is able_to_remove sin(s)

101 Ka Balaud ni Muwisis, alung de te me panalangin ne egginguma pinaahi ki Kristu wey kene ne iling sika te seeye se malehet ne panalangin. Purisu, kene egpakamatareng ka Balaud pinaahi te pegpanubad layun te tagse leg-un te seeye se migparani te Manama. 2 Su emun ke nalinisan e perem te me sale dan ka seeye se migpamakey te Manama, kene perem sikandan egkunsinsya te me sale dan, wey kene perem ne keilangan ne eg-abey pad sikandan egpanubad. 3 Piru seini se pegpanubad dan, egpasuman-suman de kandan te me sale dan te tagse leg-un. 4 Su kene egkaayun ne egpakaawe te me sale ka igpanubad dan ne langesa te turu ne baka wey te kambing.

101 The Law of Muwisis, (is) just a reflection/shadow of the blessings that come by means of Christ and is not the same as those true blessings. Therefore, the Law is not able_to_make_righteous by means of sacrificing often every year those who come_near to God. 2 For if those who served God had been_cleaned of their sins, they would not feel_guilty for their sins, and it would not be necessary that they repeat again (their) sacrifice. 3 But this sacrificing of theirs, (it) just reminds them of their sins every year. 4 For it's_ not _possible that their sacrifices of the blood of bulls and goats are able_to_remove their sins.

5 [xr]Purisu, te timpu ne miggendini si Kristu kayi te ampew te tane, migkahi sikandin diye te Manama,

5 [xr]Therefore, at the time that Christ came to earth (LIT top of the ground), he said to God,

“Ka impanubad dan wey ka inhalad dan keykew, ware nu iya ikeupii, piru imbehayan a nikeykew te lawa ne igpanubad ku.

“Their sacrifice and their offering to you(sg), you(sg) did not desire, but you(sg) gave me a body that I will_sacrifice.

6 Su ka me ayam ne intutung dan wey ka impanubad dan para te me sale dan, ware nakapahale keykew.

6 For the livestock that they burned and that they sacrificed for their sins, (it) didn't please you(sg).

7 Nataman, migkahi e man-e si Kristu, ‘Seini a, Manama, eyew te pegtuman te pegbuut nu sumale te nasulat te Kasulatan meyitenged keddi.’ ”

7 Afterwards, Christ also said, ‘Here I am, God, in_order to fulfill your(sg) will according to what is written in the Writings about me.’ ”

8 Dutu te an-anayan, migkahi si Kristu, “Ka impanubad dan wey ka inhalad dan, ka intutung dan ne ayam, wey ka impanubad dan para te me sale dan, ware nu iya ikeupii wey ware nakapahale keykew.” 9 Ne mig-abey man-e sikandin ka migkahi, “Seini a eyew te pegtuman te igkeupii nu.” Sikan naa, indapig te Manama ka an-anayan ne paahi te peg-awe te sale wey inliwanan din te igkarangeb. 10 Ne tenged su natuman ni Hisu Kristu ka pegbuut te Manama, namatulus kid e pinaahi te kasabeka re ne pegpanubad te lawa rin.

8 There at first, Christ said, “What they sacrificed and what they offered, the livestock they burned, and what they sacrificed for their sins, you(sg) indeed didn't like and it didn't please you(sg).” 9 Then again he said, “Here I am in_order to obey your(sg) desire.” So then, God set_aside the first way of removing sin and he replaced (it) with a second. 10 And since Jesus Christ fulfilled the will of God, we(incl) are made_holy through the once only sacrificing of his body.

11 [xr]Ka tagse talagpanubad, diye egsasindeg te altar te tagse aldew wey eglibed-libed egbehey te iling ded ne igpanubad. Piru seeye se igpanubad dan, kene iya egpakaawe te sale te me etew. 12 [xr]Piru si Kristu, kasabeka re mule migbehey te kandin ne lawa ne igpanubad para te me sale ta. Nataman, migpinnuu e sikandin diye te igkakawanan[fn] te Manama. 13 Ne diyad e sikandin egtetahad taman te eggimuwen e ne diekanan din ka me kuntere din. 14 Su pinaahi te seeye se kasabeka re ne pegpanubad, immatareng din te ware egtamanan ka me etew ne immatulus e.

11 [xr]Every sacrificer, (he) stands at the altar every day and repeatedly gives just the same sacrifices. But those sacrifices of theirs, (they) are truly not able_to_remove the sins of people. 12 [xr]But as for Christ, (he) on_the_contrary gave his body as a sacrifice only once for our(incl) sins. Afterwards, he sat at the right-side[fn] of God. 13 And he waits there until his enemies are made into something_ for him _to_tread_on. 14 For by means of that once only sacrifice, he made_righteous forever people who are made_holy.

15 Impamalehetan degma seini te Panisingan te Manama, su migkahi ma sikandin,

15 This is also confirmed by the Spirit of God, for he said,

16 [xr]“Ke egginguma ka seeye ne timpu, seini ka iyam ne kasabutan ne eggimuwen ku diye te kandan, kahi te Magbebaye ne Manama:

16 [xr]“When that time comes, this is the new agreement that I will_make with them, says the Lord God:

Igtahu ku ka me balaud ku diye te me pusung dan, wey igsulat ku seini diye te suman-suman dan.”

I will_put my laws into their hearts, and I will_write these into their minds.”

17 [xr]Ne migkahi pad man-e sikandin, “Kene kud e egsumsumanen ka me sale dan wey ka mareet ne me himu ran.” 18 Ne tenged su napasaylu e ka me sale, kenad e ne keilangan ne egpanubad pad.

17 [xr]Then he also said, “I will_ no_longer _remember their sins or their bad deeds.” 18 And since sins are_ already _forgiven, (it is) no_longer necessary to still sacrifice.

Kene kew leke te pegpalintutuu niyu

Don't let_go your(pl) faith

19 Purisu me suled, pinaahi te langesa ni Hisus, kene kid egkehe ne egparani diye te tangkaan te Manama.[fn] 20 Su pinaahi te impanubad ne lawa rin ne egpekeiling te makepal ne kurtina diye te timplu ne nabindas, inlukatan din para kanta ka iyam ne egbayaan eyew egpakaangken ki te umul ne ware egtamanan. 21 Ne kuntee, duen e Labew ne Talagpanubad ta ne mig-uyan te keet-etawan te Manama. 22 [xr]Purisu, keilangan ne egparani ki te Manama te ware minsan deisek ne pegduwa-ruwa[fn] duma te malehet ne pegpalintutuu ne egpuun te pusung ta. Su hendue te impatihisan e te langesa ni Kristu ka me pusung ta eyew kene kid e egkunsinsya, wey nalu-luan e te malinis ne weyig ka me lawa ta. 23 Egdesdesenan ta ka impallateng ta wey kene ki egduwa-ruwa, su egkasalihan ka Manama ne migsaad kanta. 24 Egsuman-suman ki ke egmenuwen ta te egbanasal ne egpaheyinaweey ka tagse sabeka wey eggimu te meupiya. 25 Kene ta eg-engkeran ka nabatasan ta ne peglibulung, ne kene ne iling te inggimu te duma, ke kene, egpabanasaley ki labi e te nakanengneng kid e ne mahaan egginguma ka aldew te peglibed te Magbebaye.

19 Therefore siblings, by_means of the blood of Jesus, we(incl) will_ not _hesitate to approach there in front of God.[fn] 20 Because by_means of his sacrificed body which is like the thick curtain in the temple that was torn, he opened for us(incl) the new way so_that we(incl) can_receive life without ending. 21 And now, we(incl) already have a Great/Prominent Sacrificer who rules_over the people of God. 22 [xr]Therefore, we(incl) need to approach God without even a little doubt[fn] along_with true belief from our(incl) heart(s). Because it's as if the blood of Jesus was spilled onto our(incl) hearts so_that we(incl) wouldn't have_a_bad_conscience, and our(incl) bodies were washed with clean water. 23 (Let) us(incl) hold_firmly to what we(incl) hope_for and (let) us(incl) not doubt, for God who promised us(incl) is trustworthy. 24 (Let) us(incl) consider how we(incl) will_encourage each one to love_one_another and to do good. 25 (Let) us(incl) not abandon our(incl) custom of gathering, not like others did, but rather, (let) us(incl) encourage_one_another especially since we(incl) understand that the Day of the returning of the Lord will_be_soon.

26 Su emun ke nakataha kid e te kamalehetan ne nasi ki re iya egpabulus ne egpakasale, warad e lein ne igpanubad ne egpakaawe te me sale ta. 27 [xr]Piru iyan te naan de igkeipeng ka makaaldek-haldek ne peggukum te Manama kanta, wey ka iiniti ne hapuy ne igsilab te me kuntere din. 28 [xr]Na, dengan ne timpu, ke due sabeka ne etew ne egpakasupak te Balaud ni Muwisis, eggimatayan sikandin te ware pegkeyid-u ke due daruwa wey ke tatelu naa ne egpamalehet te nakasale iya sikandin. 29 [xr]Ne sumsumana niyu kamenu karakel ka legpad ne eleg te seeye se etew ne egdeeg-deeg te Anak te Manama wey mig-isip ne ware karuan te langesa ne nakapamaresen te kasabutan ne iyan degma nakalinis kandin, wey inlemetan din ka Panisingan te Manama ne iyan mig-uyan te hid-u rin. 30 [xra][xrb]Su nakanengneng kid te migkahi ka Manama, “Sikeddiey ka egsuli wey ka egbales.” Duen pad nasulat ne miggenendue, “Eggukuman te Manama ka kandin ne keet-etawan.” 31 Makaaldek-haldek iya ke iyan eglegpad ka manekal ne Manama.

26 Because if we(incl) know the truth and we(incl) nevertheless just continue to sin, there's_no other sacrifice that can_remove our(incl) sins. 27 [xr]But the only thing left is for us(incl) to worry about God's frightening judgment of us(incl), and the hot fire that will_burn_up his enemies. 28 [xr]Now_then, a long_time ago, if there_was a person who disobeyed the Law of Muwisis, he was_killed without mercy if there were two or three who confirmed that he had indeed sinned. 29 [xr]And consider(pl) how large is the punishment that is fitting for that person who shows_contempt for the Child of God and (who) thinks there_is_no use for the blood that was_able_to_make_firm the agreement and which also cleaned him, and he insulted the Spirit of God who is the (one who) brings mercy. 30 [xra][xrb]For we(incl) know that God said, “I (am) the one to take_revenge and get_even.” It is also written like_this, “God will_judge his people.” 31 (It is) indeed frightening if the one to punish is the strong/living God.

32 Sumsumana niyu ka seeye ne timpu te iyam kew pad nalayahi meyitenged ki Kristu. Minsan nakabaye kew te masalig ne me keyirapan, piru nakasasindeg kew red. 33 Sengekakuwa, inlemetan kew wey imbaybayaran diye te tangkaan te me etew. Ne sengekakuwa ne migduma kew te seeye se nabaybayaran. 34 Su neyid-u kew te me duma niyu ne naprisu. Ne minsan in-ahawan kew te langun ne me kasangkapan niyu, indawat niyu seini duma te kahale tenged su nakanengneng kew ne duen pad egkarawat niyu ne subla pad ne meupiya wey egpabulus te ware egtamanan. 35 Purisu, kene niyu engkeri ka pegsalig niyu te Manama su due dakel ne igdasag kaniyu. 36 Keilangan ne eg-antus kew pad eyew egkatuman niyu ka pegbuut te Manama, ne egkataman egkarawat niyu ka insaad din. 37 [xr]Su migkahi ka Manama diye te Kasulatan,

32 Think(pl) about that time when you(pl) were recently enlightened about Christ. Although you(pl) underwent/passed_through many difficulties, nevertheless you(pl) were_ still _able_to_stand. 33 Sometimes, you(pl) were insulted and persecuted in front of people. And sometimes you(pl) accompanied those who were persecuted. 34 For you(pl) had compassion on your(pl) companions who were imprisoned. And even when all of your(pl) possessions were_taken from you(pl), you(pl) accepted this with joy because you(pl) knew that there are still things you(pl) will_receive that are much better and which will_continue forever. 35 Therefore, don't(pl) abandon your(pl) trust in God for there_is a great gift/reward for you(pl). 36 You(pl) need to endure so_that you(pl) will_fulfill the will of God, and then you(pl) will_receive what he promised. 37 [xr]For God said in the Writings,

“Te kene egkaluhey, eggingume e ka egtetaharan niyu,

“In not a long_time, the one you(pl) are waiting for will_arrive,

kene eglamu-lamu sikandin.

he will_ not _be_late.

38 Ka keet-etawan ne in-isip ku ne matareng, egkeuyag te ware egtamanan pinaahi te pegpalintutuu ran keddi.

38 The people whom I considered righteous, will_live without ending by_means of their faith in me.

Piru ke eg-inniyuhan a nikandan, kena ad egkahale kandan.”

But if they turn_away from me, I will_ not _be_pleased with them.”

39 Piru meyitenged kanta, kene ki mule ne iling te me etew ne mig-inniyug e te Manama wey eglegparan e te ware egtamanan, ke kene, egpekeiling ki te me etew ne migpalintutuu wey egkaluwas.

39 But concerning us(incl), we(incl) are_ not _like the people who turned_away from God and are punished without ending, but rather, we(incl) are_like the people who believed and are_saved.

Ka pegpalintutuu te dengan ne me etew

The faith of the long_ago people

111 Na, nekey-a ka pegpalintutuu? Ka pegpalintutuu, iyan sika ka kasihuruwan ne egkatuman iya ka impallateng te etew, wey minsan ware din pad nakita, egpakatahe e sikandin ne egginguma iya sika. 2 Su tenged te pegpalintutuu, indayan te Manama ka me etew dengan. 3 [xr]Tenged te pegpalintutuu, natahaan ta ne inggimu ka kalibutan pinaahi te lalag te Manama. Purisu seini se egkakita ta, inggimu puun te kene ta egkakita.

111 Now_then, what is faith? Faith, it is the assurance that a person's hope will_ truly _be_fulfilled, and even_though he hasn't yet seen (it), he understands that it will_ truly _happen (LIT arrive). 2 For because of faith, God praised the people long_ago. 3 [xr]Because of faith, we(incl) understand that the world was_made by means of the word of God. Therefore this that we(incl) see, (it) was_made from what we(incl) don't see.

4 [xr]Tenged te pegpalintutuu, migbehey si Abil diye te Manama te meupiya pad ne impanubad du te ki Kain ne suled din. Impapitew te Manama ne in-isip din si Abil ne matareng su indawat din ka impanubad ni Abil. Ne minsan migpatey e si Abil, egkahuhud pad ka meyitenged te pegpalintutuu rin te Manama.

4 [xr]Because of faith, Abil gave to God a better sacrifice than Kain his sibling. God showed that he considered Abil righteous because he accepted the sacrifice of Abil. And although Abil died, his faith in God is still spoken of.

5 [xr]Tenged te pegpalintutuu, ware migpatey si Inuk su imbatun mule sikandin. Warad e kitaa sikandin kayi te tane su imbatun ma te Manama. Ne sumale te Kasulatan, te ware pad batuna si Inuk, ingkahale sikandin te Manama. 6 Ne kene iya egkaayun ne egkahale ka Manama te etew ne ware pegpalintutuu. Su minsan hentew ne egparani te Manama, keilangan ne egpalintutuu ne due iya Manama, wey egdasahan din ka langun ne egpamitew kandin.

5 [xr]Because of faith, Inuk did not die because he was_taken_up instead. He was no_longer seen here on the ground because (he was) taken_up by God. Now according to the Writings, when Inuk had_ not yet _been_taken_up, he pleased God. 6 And it's_ truly not _possible for God to be pleased by a person without faith. For whoever comes_near to God, (he) needs to believe that God truly exists, and he rewards all who seek him.

7 [xr]Tenged te pegpalintutuu, intuman ni Nuwi ka impaney-paney te Manama kandin meyitenged te egkeyitabu keureme, minsan ware din pad nakita seini. Purisu miggimu sikandin te arka eyew egkaluwas sikandin wey ka pamilya rin. Ne puun due, inggukuman te Manama ka me etew kayi te ampew te tane tenged su ware sikandan migpalintutuu. Piru si Nuwi, in-isip mule ne matareng tenged te pegpalintutuu rin.

7 [xr]Because of faith, Nuwi obeyed God's warning to him concerning what would_happen in_the_future, although he had_ not yet _seen it. Therefore he made an ark so_that he and his family would_be_saved. And from that, God judged the people here on earth (LIT on top of the ground) because they didn't believe. But Nuwi, (he) on_the_contrary was_considered righteous as a result of his faith.

8 [xr]Tenged te pegpalintutuu, intuman ni Abraham ka inlalag te Manama ne egpeendiyeen te inged ne igbehey kandin te Manama. In-engkeran din ka kandin ne inged minsan ware din nakataha ke hendei lenged ka egpeendiyaan kandin. 9 [xr]Tenged te pegpalintutuu, nekeugpe sikandin ne egpekeiling te lapu diye te inged ne insaad te Manama kandin. Ne diye de mig-ugpe sikandin te me balungbalung, iling degma te anak din ne si Isaak wey te apu din ne si Hakub, ne namehayan ded degma te Manama te sika ne saad. 10 Su mig-iman-iman si Abraham ne egpekeugpe te siyudad diye te langit, ne kene egkaawe ne implanu wey impasasindeg te Manama.

8 [xr]Because of faith, Abraham obeyed what_ God _said that sent (him) to a place that God would give to him. He abandoned his own place even_though he didn't know where he was being sent to. 9 [xr]Because of faith, he lived like a foreigner in the place which God had_promised to him. And he lived there in just a tent, like also his child Isaak and his grandchild Hakub, who were_ also _given that promise by God. 10 For Abraham expected to be_able_to_live in the city in heaven, that will_ not _be_removed and that was planned and built by God.

11 [xr]Tenged man-e te pegpalintutuu, nakaanak pad ensi Abraham minsan amane e ne buyag sikandan wey kenad e perem egpakaanak si Sara ne asawa rin. Migpalintutuu sikandin ne egtumanen te Manama ka insaad din ne egpakaanak iya si Sara. 12 [xr]Purisu, minsan sabeka re ne etew si Abraham ne suble e ne buyag wey kenad e perem egpakaanak, piru sikandin ka egpuunan te me kabuhalan ne iling kasulug te me bituen te langit, wey iling degma te me lelanek diye te ilis te dahat ne kene egkaseel.

11 [xr]Again because of faith, Abraham(pl) were_ still _able_to_procreate even_though they were_ very _old and Sara his spouse should no_longer have_been_able_to_procreate. He believed that God would fulfill his promise that Sara would indeed be_able_to_procreate. 12 [xr]Therefore, although Abraham was only one person who was very old and should not have_been_able_to_procreate, he was the source of as many descendants as stars in the sky, and also as the sands on the shore of the sea that can't be counted.

13 [xr]Nammatey re due ka seeye se langun ne etew ne migpalintutuu te Manama, ne ware nakarawat te insaad kandan. Piru iling te nakita ran e ka insaad te Manama kandan wey nahale sikandan. Mig-angken sikandan ne me lapu de wey mahaliyug de kayi te ampew te tane. 14 Ne seini se me etew ne miglalag te iling due, migpeila re iya ne egpamitew sikandan te malehet ne inged dan. 15 Ware dan e sumsumana ka impuunan dan ne inged, su emun ke migsuman-suman pad sikandan due, nanguli e perem sikandan. 16 Piru iyan dan igkeupii mule ka subla pad ne meupiya ne inged, ka inged diye te langit. Purisu kene egkeyilew ka Manama ne eg-angkenen nikandan ne sikandin ka Manama ran, tenged su intahahaan din e sikandan te siyudad diye te langit.

13 [xr]All those people who believed God, (they) just died without receiving what was promised them. But (it's) like they saw what God promised them and they were_happy. They acknowledged that (they) were just foreigners and visitors here on the top of the ground. 14 And these people who spoke like that, (they) really showed that they are seeking their true place. 15 They don't think about the place where they (are) from, for if they still thought about it, they would have returned_home. 16 But what they desire on_the_contrary is a better place, a place in heaven. Therefore God is not ashamed to acknowledge them that he is their God, because he has already prepared a city in heaven for them.

17-18 [xr]Tenged te pegpalintutuu, igpanubad e perem ni Abraham si Isaak te in-el-elehan sikandin te Manama. [xr]Ne minsan sikandin ka migsaaran te Manama ne ka anak din ka egkeyimu ne egpuunan te me kabuhalan din, piru andam sikandin ne igpanubad ka sabsabeka ne anak din ne si Isaak. 19 Su migpalintutuu sikandin ne minsan egpatey si Isaak piru eg-uyahen ded iya te Manama, purisu hendue te in-uyag ded iya te Manama si Isaak puun te kamatayen[fn] wey miglibed diye te ki Abraham.

17-18 [xr]Because of faith, Abraham would have sacrificed Isaak when he (Abraham) was tested by God. [xr]And even though he (Abraham) was the one promised by God that his child would_become the source of his descendants, nevertheless he was prepared to sacrifice his only child Isaak. 19 For he believed that even if Isaak died nevertheless God would just raise (him), therefore it's as if God just indeed raised Isaak from the dead[fn] and returned (him) to Abraham.

20 [xr]Tenged te pegpalintutuu, impanalanginan ni Isaak ka daruwa ne anak din ne si Hakub wey si Isaw wey intagne din ka egkeula-ula ran keureme.

20 [xr]Because of faith, Isaak blessed his two children Hakub and Isaw and he prophecied their future events.

21 [xra][xrb]Tenged te pegpalintutuu, impanalanginan ni Hakub ka daruwa ne apu din ne anak ni Husi te ware pad sikandin nabigtawi. Ne migsimba sikandin te Manama ne mig-usengul te tuked din.

21 [xra][xrb]Because of faith, Hakub blessed his two grandchildren who were the children of Husi when he had_ not yet _lost_breath. And he worshiped God leaning_over his staff.

22 [xr]Tenged te pegpalintutuu, intagne ni Husi te ware pad sikandin nabigtawi ka meyitenged te peg-awe te me kabuhalan ni Israil diye te Ihiptu, wey migpanaha-taha degma sikandin kandan ne igpeuyan ded ka tul-an din te peg-awe dan.

22 [xr]Because of faith, Husi predicted when he was not yet dying about the departure of the descendants of Israil from Ihiptu, and he also gave_final_instructions to them to cause_(them)_to_take his bones upon their departure.

23 [xra][xrb]Tenged te pegpalintutuu, te peglesut ni Muwisis, inggeles sikandin te amey wey iney rin seled te tatelu ne bulan. Su nakita ran ne mateles sikandin ne bate wey ware sikandan naaldek ne egsupak te suhu te Hari.

23 [xra][xrb]Because of faith, at Muwisis' birth, he was hidden by his father and mother for three months. For they saw that he was a beautiful child and they were not afraid to disobey the command of the king.

24 [xr]Tenged te pegpalintutuu, te pegtulin e ni Muwisis, kenad e egkeupian sikandin ne eg-an-anaken te malitan ne anak te Hari te Ihiptu. 25 In-alam din ka peg-antus duma te kabuhalan ni Israil ne keet-etawan te Manama du te peggale-gale te sale ne egpakapahale de te kene egkaluhey. 26 Migsuman-suman sikandin ne meupiya pad ne eg-antus sikandin ka eglemetan tenged te pegpalintutuu rin te egginguma ne Kristu, du te egpakaangken te karatuan te Ihiptu. Su mig-iman-iman sikandin ne due igdasag te Manama kandin keureme.

24 [xr]Because of faith, when Muwisis was grown, he no_longer wanted to be_considered_an_offspring of the female child of the king of Ihiptu. 25 He chose suffering along_with the descendants of Israil who (are) the people of God rather than the pleasure of sin which is only able_to_please for a short_time (LIT not a long time). 26 He decided that it is better for him to endure being mocked due to his belief in the coming Christ, than to be_able_to_possess the wealth of Ihiptu. For he expected that there would_be a future reward_given to him by God.

27 Tenged te pegpalintutuu, mig-awe si Muwisis diye te Ihiptu ne ware naaldek te pegkabelu te Hari. Migpabulus sikandin ka migsalig te Manama minsan te me keyirapan su hendue te nakita rin e ka Manama ne kene egkakita. 28 [xr]Tenged te pegpalintutuu, migbunsud migsahakeen si Muwisis te Peglihad te Panalihan. Ne migsuhu sikandin ne egpabesikan te langesa te karniru ka gumawan te me kabuhalan ni Israil, eyew kene egkalagkes te pegpangimatey te panalihan te Manama ka me panganey ne anak dan ne lukes.

27 As a result of faith, Muwisis left Ihiptu and didn't fear the anger of the king. He continued to trust God despite difficulties because it was as_if he saw the God who can't be seen. 28 [xr]Because of faith, Muwisis started celebrating the Feast of Passing_by of the Angel. And he commanded that the doorways of the descendants of Israil be splattered with the blood of sheep, so_that their eldest male children would not be included in the killings by the angel of God.

29 [xr]Tenged te pegpalintutuu, nekeyipanew sikandan te mammara ne tane te peglapas dan diye te Malalab ne Dahat. Piru nallened mule ka me Ihiptuhanen ne miglupug kandan.

29 [xr]Because of faith, they walked on dry ground when they crossed the Red Sea. But the Egyptians on_the_contrary drowned when chasing them.

30 [xr]Tenged te pegpalintutuu te kabuhalan ni Israil, nahuhus ka alad te siyudad te Hiriku te pegkapenga ran te peglingut-lingut dutu seled te senge-simana.

30 [xr]Because of the faith of the descendants of Israil, the fence of the city of Hiriku collapsed when the one week that they went_around_and_around (it) was completed.

31 [xra][xrb]Tenged te pegpalintutuu, ka malitan ne migbebelegye te lawa rin ne si Rahab, ware sikandin nakalagkes namatey te seeye se matig-Hiriku ne ware migpalintutuu te Manama, su insagsahipe din ka me talag-iipat.

31 [xra][xrb]Because of faith, the woman who was the prostitute (LIT sold her body) Rahab, she wasn't included (when) those (ones) from_Jericho who didn't believe God died, because she welcomed the spies.

32 [xra][xrb][xrc][xrd][xre][xrf]Na, kayi re taman ka igguhud ku kaniyu meyitenged te me etew ne migpalintutuu te Manama, tenged su warad e timpu te pegpangguhud meyitenged engki Gidyun, ki Barak, ki Samsun, ki Hipta, ki Dabid, ki Samwil wey te me prupita dengan. 33 [xr]Tenged te pegpalintutuu ran, due duma ne nakapanalu te me nasud; due duma ne eleg ka peggukum dan; due duma ne nakarawat te insaad te Manama kandan, wey due duma ne nakapatiem te be-be te me liyun. 34 [xr]Due duma ne ware natutung te migkanlabkanlab ne hapuy, wey due duma ne nakapallahuy te me etew ne egtibbas perem kandan. Minsan mahuye ka duma piru imbehayan sikandan te kanekal. Due duma ne mabbulut wey natalu ran ka me sundalu te duma ne me nasud. 35 [xr]Due degma me malitan ne neuyahan te me anak dan ne nammatey. Ne due duma ne migsuman-suman ne meupiya pad ka egbaybayaran taman te kamatayen tenged te pegpalintutuu ran du te egdawat te kaligwangan. Su mig-iman-iman sikandan ne egginguma ka aldew ne eg-uyahen ded sikandan te Manama wey egkarawat dan ka subla pad ne meupiya ne umul. 36 [xr]Due duma ne inlemetan wey impanlampesan, ne ka duma impamaku wey imprisu. 37 [xr]Ne due degma duma ne innimatayan, iling te imbebatu, impaliwliwaraan te eggabas, wey intitibbas te kampilan. Ne due duma ne nangukumbale naan de te laplap te karniru wey kambing. Amane e egkaayu-ayu sikandan, imbaybayaran, wey impaantus pad man-e. 38 Migleug-leug sikandan diye te mammara ne inged ne kene egkeugpaan, diye te me bubungan, wey diye nangugpe te me sulung wey te me lungag te tane. Ka malehet due, kene ne likes ka kalibutan para kandan.

32 [xra][xrb][xrc][xrd][xre][xrf]Now_then, this ends (LIT just this far) my telling to you(pl) about the people who believed God, since there_is_no more time for storying about Gidyun, Barak, Samsun, Hipta, Dabid, Samwil or the prophets long_ago. 33 [xr]Because of faith, there were others who defeated nations; there were others whose ruling was righteous; there were others who received the promise of God to them, and there were others who were able_to_cause_ the mouths of lions _to_shut. 34 [xr]There were others who were not burned by flaming fire, and there were others who were able_to_flee from people who would have slashed them. Although others were weak they were_given strength. There were others who were fierce and they defeated soldiers of other nations. 35 [xr]There were also women whose children that died were raised. And there were others who thought that it is better to be_persecuted until death because of their faith rather than to accept freedom. For they anticipated that the day will_come when God will_raise them and they will_receive a better life. 36 [xr]There were others who were insulted and beaten, and others were bound and imprisoned. 37 [xr]And there were also others who were_killed, like the ones_stoned, sawed in half (ones), and the ones_stabbed with a sword/dagger. And there were others who were_clothed only in the skin of sheep and goats. They were very poor, persecuted, and caused_to_suffer as well. 38 They wandered in the place without local_inhabitants, in the mountains, and lived in caves and in holes in the ground. The truth of it (is), the world is not worthy of them.

39 Seini se langun, ingkahale te Manama tenged te pegpalintutuu ran. Piru minsan pad due, ware dan narawat ka langun ne insaad te Manama kandan. 40 Su due meupiya pad ne planu te Manama ne nalagkes ki degma. Taman kuntee, ware natuman ka saad din diye te kandan su eyew egmekeglegse ki ka egdawat te insaad din, wey egkeyimu ki ne keet-etawan din ne ware seyyup.

39 All of these, (they) pleased God as a result of their faith. But despite that, they did not receive all that God promised them. 40 For God has a better plan that includes us(incl) also. Until today, his promise to them was not fulfilled so_that we(incl) will_receive together what he has promised, and we(incl) will_become his people without fault.

Ka pegpakannekal te pegpalintutuu taman te katamanan

Striving to believe until the end

121 Sikan naa, tenged su nalingutan ki kuntee te seeye se susuluhi ne me etew dengan ne egpamalehet kanta ne egkasalihan ka Manama, keilangan ne eg-engkeran ta ka langun ne egpakabalabag kanta wey ka sale ne iyan egpakabakus kanta. Ne egpabulus ki ka egpallahuy te lumba ne intahahe kanta. 2 Keilangan ne iyan te re egtengtengan si Hisus, ka egpuunan wey ka talagmalehet te pegpalintutuu ta. Imbalahad din de ka keyilew rin perem te pegpalansang te krus, tenged te kahale ne egkarawat din pegkapenga te peg-antus din. Ne kuntee, diyad e sikandin migpinnuu te igkakawanan[fn] te trunu te Manama.

121 And so, since we(incl) are now surrounded by those many people (from) long_ago who confirm to us(incl) that God is faithful, we(incl) need to leave_behind all that blocks us(incl) and the sin(s) that binds us(incl). And let_ us(incl) _continue to run the race prepared for us(incl). 2 (It is) necessary that what we(incl) focus on is Jesus, the source and the corrector of our(incl) faith. He just ignored his potential (ie what could have shamed him) shame at being_nailed to the cross, as a result of the joy that he will_receive after his suffering. And now, he is seated at the right-side[fn] of the throne of God.

3 Sumsumana niyu si Hisus se mig-antus te pegsupak te me etew ne makasesale, eyew kene kew egkapelaan wey eg-engked. 4 Ne ware de due migpatey kaniyu puun te pegpakannekal rin te pegtalu te sale. 5 [xr]Ne ware niyu red nalingawi ka pegbagget te Manama kaniyu isip me anak din? Migkahi sikandin diye te Kasulatan,

3 Think(pl) about Jesus who suffered the opposition of people who were sinners, so_that you(pl) will_ not _become tired and quit. 4 And none of you(pl) there have yet died from his/her striving to defeat sin. 5 [xr]And you(pl) haven't forgotten the encouragement of God to you(pl) as his children? (NOTE This doesn't translate well into English where we() wouldn't use the negative but in Matigsalug this is the more polite form) He said in the scriptures,

“Anak ku, kene nu balahara ka pegdisiplina te Manama keykew, wey kene ka engked ke egdew-ayen ka nikandin.

“My child, don't ignore the discipline of God to you(sg), and don't quit if he scolds you(sg).

6 Su ka eggeyinawaan te Manama, egdisiplineen din, wey eglegparan din seeye se in-ila rin ne anak din.”

6 For the ones God loves, he disciplines, and he punishes those whom he recognizes as his children.”

7 Antusa niyu ka keyirapan isip disiplina te Manama kaniyu, tenged su in-isip kew nikandin ne me anak din. Duen naan iya anak ne kene egdisiplineen te amey? 8 Piru ke kene kew egdisiplineen iling te eggimuwen din te langun ne me anak din, kene kew naa ne malehet ne me anak din; anak kew re te dalan. 9 Minsan ka me amey ta kayi te ampew te tane, migdisiplina ma kanta, wey intahud ta sikandan tenged due. Na, subla pad ne egparuma-ruma ki te Amey ta ne diye te langit eyew egpakaangken ki te umul. 10 Su ka me amey ta kayi te ampew te tane, migdisiplina kanta te ware de naluhey sumale te insuman-suman dan ne meupiya. Piru ka pegdisiplina te Manama kanta para iya te keupianan ta, eyew egkeyimu ki ne matulus iling kandin. 11 Ware pegdisiplina ne egpakapahale taheed te eggimuwen sika, su masakit iya. Piru te katammanan, seeye se nakabaye te pegdisiplina, egmalinawen e ka suman-suman wey egmatareng e ka batasan.

7 Suffer(pl) difficulties as the discipline of God to you(pl), because that's what he does to his children. Is there any child that is not disciplined by (his/her) father? 8 But if you(pl) are_ not _disciplined like what he does to all of his children, you(pl) are not his true children; you(pl) are just illegitimate children (LIT children of the path). 9 Even our(incl) fathers here on top of the ground, disciplined us(incl), and we(incl) respected them as a result of that. Now_then, even more will we(incl) comply to our(incl) Father in heaven so_that we(incl) will_be_able_to_possess life. 10 For our(incl) fathers here on the top of the ground, (they) disciplined us(incl) for a short time (LIT not a long time) according to what they thought was good. But God's discipline of us(incl) is really for our(incl) peace/well-being, so_that we(incl) will_become holy like him. 11 There_is_no discipline that pleases while it is being done, for it really hurts. But in the end, those who go_through discipline, (their) thoughts become peaceful and (their) behavior becomes righteous.

12 [xr]Purisu kayawa niyu ka napu-pu ne me belad niyu wey lig-ena niyu ka mahuye ne me buel niyu. 13 [xr]Tul-ira niyu ka dalan ne egbayaan niyu, su eyew seeye se pungku kene egkabalingu, ke kene, nasi egkeulii.

12 [xr]Therefore lift_up your(pl) tired hands/arms and strengthen your(pl) weak knees. 13 [xr]Straighten(pl) the path that you(pl) are traveling_on, so_that the lame won't get twisted, but rather, instead be healed.

Ka pegpaney-paney meyitenged te peg-inniyug te Manama

The warning about turning_(your)_back on God

14 Pakannekali niyu ne malinawen ka peg-ugpe niyu duma te me etew wey egmatulus kew, su ke ware sika, ware sabeka ne egpakakita te Manama. 15 [xr]Bantey kew degma ne ware sabeka kaniyu ne eg-inniyug te keupiya te Manama. Pakannekali niyu ne ware sabeka ne egpekeiling te mapeit ne hilamunen ne iyan egpuunan te kasamuk due te kaniyu wey egpakamalindit te kasuluhan. 16 [xr]Bantey kew ne ware sabeka kaniyu ne egpangabid, wey ware due te kaniyu ne kene egkaaldek te Manama iling ki Isaw te migbubullas te katenged din te pegkapanganey rin te senge-keenan de. 17 [xr]Te katammanan, nakataha kew e ne timpu ne egkeupian ded perem sikandin ne egpakarawat te panalangin din, ware sikandin behayi tenged su kene din egkabalbalawan ka inggimu rin minsan ke egsinehew pad sikandin.

14 Strive(pl) that your(pl) living among people will_be_peaceful and become_holy(pl), for without that, no one will_be_able_to_see God. 15 [xr]Guard(pl) also_that not one of you(pl) turns-(his)_back on God's goodness. Strive(pl) also_that no one is like a bitter plant that is the source of disagreements among you(pl) and dirties many. 16 [xr]Guard(pl) that not one of you(pl) commits_immorality, and that there_is_none among you(pl) who doesn't fear God like Isaw who exchanged his right/responsibility of his being_firstborn for just one meal. 17 [xr]In the end, you(pl) know that at the time that he wanted to receive his blessing, he wasn't given (it) because he couldn't change what he did even if/when he cried.

18 [xr]Ka pegparani niyu kuntee diye te Manama, kene ne iling te pegparani dengan te kabuhalan ni Israil diye te Manama. Migparani sikandan te bubungan ne egkahen-genan ne due hapuy ne migkanlabkanlab, durusilemi, wey kekesehi ka kalamag. 19 Ne nakarineg sikandan te dahing te trumpita wey te laheng te Manama. Te pegkarineg dan e te laheng, migpeyimmimenew e sikandan ne kenad e egpalalahen. 20 [xr]Su kene egpakaantus sikandan te insuhu te laheng ne miggenendue, “Minsan ke due mananap ne egdiek te seini ne bubungan, keilangan ne egbatuwen taman te egpatey.” 21 [xr]Makaalat-halat ka nakita ran ne minsan si Muwisis nakakahi, “Egkelkelen ad te pegkaaldek ku.”

18 [xr]Your(pl) approaching God today, (it) is not like the approaching God by the descendants of Israil long_ago. They approached a mountain that can be touched that had fire blazing, heavy_darkness, and a very_strong_wind. 19 And they heard the sound of a trumpet and the voice of God. When they heard the voice, they pleaded that (it) speak no more. 20 [xr]For they were_ not _able_to_endure the command of the voice that went_like_this, “If there_is even a wild_animal that steps on this mountain, (it) needs to be stoned until it dies.” 21 [xr]What they saw was terrifying and even Muwisis said, “I tremble with fear.”

22 Piru sikaniyu mule, ka Bubungan ne Siyun ka imparaniyan niyu, ka siyudad te manekal ne Manama, ne iyan ka Hirusalim ne diye te langit ne miglibulungan te egkahale-gale ne me panalihan ne kene egkaseel. 23 Migparani kew te nanlibulung ne me etew ne in-isip te Manama ne mabantug ne me anak din,[fn] ne nasulat e se me ngaran diye te langit. Migparani kew degma diye te Manama ne talaggukum te langun ne etew, wey migsabeka kew te seeye se nammatey e ne immatareng e te Manama ne warad e me kulang. 24 [xr]Migparani kew ki Hisus ne iyan tigpataliware kanta wey te Manama te iyam ne kasabutan. Ka impatihis ne langesa rin migpamalehet ne impasaylu kid e, wey meupiya pad seini du te langesa ni Abil ne migbuyu te pegsuli.

22 But you(pl) on_the_contrary, Mount Siyun is where you(pl) approach, the city of the strong/living God, which is the Hirusalim in sky/heaven and the gathering_place of joyful angels who can't be counted. 23 You(pl) approached the gathering of the people whom God considers his prestigious children,[fn] whose names are listed in sky/heaven. You(pl) also approached God who is the judge of all people, and have joined with those who already died and whom God already made righteous and no_longer lack anything. 24 [xr]You(pl) approached Jesus who is the mediator (LIT cause_to_come_between_one) between us(incl) and God. His blood that spilled confirms that we(incl) are forgiven, and it's better than the blood of Abil that begs revenge.

25 [xr]Na, bantey kew ne kene kew egpalingeg-lingeg te iglalag te Manama kaniyu. Su ka me etew dengan ne ware miglinga-linga te inlalag te Manama kandan kayi te ampew te tane, ware nakapanalliya te legpad. Ne iyan ki naan pa iya kene legpari, ke kene ta eglinglingeen ka iglalag kanta ne diye egpuun te langit! 26 [xr]Te seeye ne timpu, nawelwel ka tane tenged te laheng te Manama, piru kuntee migsaad sikandin ne miggenendue, “Egwelwelen ku pad eg-abayi ka tane, ne kene ne tane de, ke kene, ka langit degma.” 27 Ka seini se lalag din ne, “Eg-abayan pad,” iyan igpasabut kayi ne eg-aween din ka langun ne inggimu rin ne egkawelwel, eyew iyan naan de egkahaat ka kene egkawelwel.

25 [xr]Now_then, watch lest you(pl) don't pay_attention to what_ God _is_saying to you(pl). Because the people long_ago who didn't take_notice of what_ God _said to them here on top of the earth, didn't avoid the punishment. So (do_you_think) we(incl) won't be_punished, if we(incl) don't pay_attention to what is_said to us(incl) from the sky/heaven! 26 [xr]At that time, the ground shook as a result of the voice of God, but now he promised like_this, “I will_shake the ground yet again, and not just the ground, but rather, the sky/heaven also.” 27 These words of his, “Yet again,” what it means is that he will_remove all that he made that can be shaken, so_that all that is left behind can't be shaken.

28 Purisu keilangan ne egpasalamat ki te Manama tenged su egpekeugpe kid e te migharian din ne kene egkawelwel. Keilangan ne egsimbeen ta ka Manama te paahi ne egpakapahale kandin duma te pegtahud wey te pegpariralem ta. 29 [xr]Su ka Manama ta, egpekeiling te hapuy ne egpekewugmas.

28 Therefore we(incl) need to thank God because our(incl) living in his kingdom can't be shaken. We(incl) need to worship God in a way that pleases him along_with respect and our(incl) humility. 29 [xr]For our(incl) God, (he) is like a fire that is able_to_completely_consume.

Egmenuwen ta te pegpahale te Manama

How will_ we(incl) _please God

131 Na, pabulus kew paheyinaweey isip tahasuled. 2 [xr]Kene kew kalingew ne eg-al-alumama te mahaliyug ne ware niyu neileyi. Su due duma dengan ne mig-al-alumama te mahaliyug ne ware nakanengneng te me panalihan bes e seeye. 3 Ikeyid-u niyu seeye se nenaprisu wey seeye se mig-antus, wey gedgerama niyu degma ka keugpe dan.

131 Now_then, continue(pl) to love_one_another as siblings/cousins. 2 [xr]Don't(pl) forget to be hospitable to visitors whom you(pl) don't know. For there were others long_ago who were hospitable to visitor(s) who didn't realize that they (surprise) were angels. 3 Show_pity(pl) on those imprisoned(pl) and those suffering, and feel(pl) also their situation.

4 Keilangan ne ka asaweey egtahuren te langun, wey kene egpanlibug ka alunggun. Su ka egpanlibug wey ka egpangabid, eglegparan te Manama.

4 (It is) necessary that marriage is respected by all, and the couple doesn't commit_adultery. For the adulterer and the immoral, (they) will_be_punished by God.

5 [xr]Pakaddiyu kew te peggeyinawa te seleppi, wey keilangan ne egkabennalan kew ke nekey ka due te kaniyu. Su seini ka ingkahi te Manama, “Kene kud iya eg-engkeran sikaniyu wey eg-inniyuhan.” 6 [xr]Sikan naa ka kene ki egkehe ne egkahi,

5 [xr]Distance (yourselves) from loving money, and it's_necessary that you(pl) be content with whatever you(pl) have. Because here is what God said, “I will_ truly not _abandon you(pl) or turn_away from (you).” 6 [xr]And so we(incl) don't fear to say,

“Ka Manama ka talagbulig ku,

“God is my helper,

purisu kena a egkaaldek.

therefore I am_ not _afraid.

Nekey ma ka egkeyimu te etew kayi te keddiey?”

What will a person do to me?”

7 Sumsumana niyu ka me pangulu niyu, seeye se migpanulu dengan kaniyu te lalag te Manama. Sumsumana niyu ka neyingumaan te peg-ugpe dan, ne ilingi niyu naa ka pegpalintutuu ran. 8 Si Hisu Kristu, kene egkabalbalawan puun pad dengan, kuntee, wey te ware egtamanan. 9 Purisu kene kew peuyan te minsan nekey ne lein ne klasi te pegpanulu. Ne meupiya ke egkalig-en ka me pusung ta pinaahi te keyid-u te Manama, ne kene ne pinaahi te balaud meyitenged te egkakeen. Kene egpakabulig sika te seeye se eg-ikul. 10 Kayi te kanta, ka peglansang ki Hisus diye te krus ka hendue te kanta ne altar. Piru ka me Hudiyu ne migpabulus-bulus pad ne migpanubad, kene egpakakuwa te kapasayluwan te me sale pinaahi kayi.[fn] 11 [xr]Ne ka langesa te me ayam, eg-uyanen te labew ne talagpanubad diye te Subla ne Matulus ne Sinabeng isip igpanubad te peglinis te me sale, piru ka me lawa, eg-uyanen dan diye te lihawangan te kampu wey diye dan egtutunga. 12 Ne iling naan ded, mig-antus degma si Hisus diye te lihawangan te siyudad eyew te pegmatulus te me etew pinaahi te kandin mismu ne langesa. 13 Sikan naa, eg-engkeran tad ka tapey ne tuluuwen[fn] wey eg-ambag kid eg-antus te pegkeyilew rin. 14 Su kayi te ampew te tane, ware siyudad ta ne kene egkaawe piru eg-im-imanen ta ka siyudad ne eg-ugpaan ta keureme.

7 Remember(pl) your(pl) leaders, those who taught you(pl) the word of God long_ago. Remember(pl) the outcome (LIT arrival) of their living, and imitate(pl) their faith. 8 Jesus Christ, is_ not _changed from long_ago, today, and forever (LIT without end). 9 Therefore don't(pl) be_carried_(away) with various different kinds of teachings. And it's good if our(incl) hearts are strengthened by_means of the mercy of God, and not by_means of the law about eating. That can't_help those that follow (it). 10 Here with us(incl), the nailing of Jesus to the cross is like our(incl) altar. But the Hudiyus that just continue sacrificing(animals), (they) can't avail of the forgiveness of sins by_means of this.[fn] 11 [xr]And the blood of livestock, (it) is carried by the great/prominent sacrificer to the Very Holy Room as a sacrifice for cleaning sins, but the bodies, they carry outside the camp and there they burn_it. 12 Now just like that, Jesus also suffered outside the city in_order to make_holy the people by_means of his own blood. 13 So then, (let) us(incl) leave_behind the old practice(s)/belief(s)[fn] and (let) us(incl) join_in the shame he suffered. 14 For here on the top of the ground, we(incl) have_no city that will_ not _be_removed but we(incl) anticipate the city where we(incl) will_live_in in_the_future.

15 Purisu, keilangan ne egpabulus ki egsaye te Manama pinaahi ki Hisus, isip halad ne egpuun te be-be[fn] te seeye se eg-angken kandin. 16 Kene kew kalingew ne eggimu te meupiya wey pabulihey kew ka tagse sabeka, su iyan sika ka peghalad ne egpakapahale te Manama.

15 Therefore, we(incl) need to continue to praise God by means of Jesus, as an offering/sacrifice that is from the mouth(s)[fn] of those who acknowledge him. 16 Don't(pl) forget to do good and for everyone to_help_one_another, for that is the offering that is able_to_please God.

17 Tumana niyu ka me pangulu niyu wey paruma-ruma kew kandan, su sikandan ka egtanggu te pegpalintutuu niyu wey ka egpanabak diye te Manama te pegtanggu ran. Emun ke egtumanen niyu sikandan, eggimu sikandan ne due kahale, piru ke kene, egkabehatan sikandan te himu ran wey kene degma egpakabulig sika kaniyu.

17 Obey(pl) your(pl) leaders and comply_with them, for they are caretakers of your(pl) faith and the ones_to_answer to God for their caretaking. If you(pl) obey them, they will_work with joy, but if not, they will_be_weighed_down with their work and that will_ also not _help you(pl).

18 Pabulus kew ampu kanami. Nakanengneng key ne malinis iya ka kunsinsya ney wey egkeupian key ne eleg ka langun ne eggimuwen ney. 19 Eghangyuen ku iya sikaniyu ne eg-ampu keddi eyew egpaliberen e pad te Manama due te kaniyu te kene egkaluhey.

18 Continue(pl) to pray for us(excl). We(excl) know that our(excl) consciences are indeed clear and we(excl) want for everything we(excl) do to be right. 19 I truly request/plead you(pl) to pray for me so_that God will_return me to you(pl) in a short time (LIT not a long time).

Ka katammanan ne peg-ampu wey pegpanaha-taha

The final prayer and goodbye

20 In-uyag te Manama ne egpuunan te keupianan ka Magbebaye ta ne si Hisus. Egpekeiling sikandin te maresen ne talagtameng te me karniru, ne pinaahi te langesa rin, napamalehetan din ka ware katammanan ne kasabutan. 21 Ka Manama ka egbehey kaniyu te langun ne meupiya ne ingkeilangan niyu te pegtuman te pegbuut din. Ne pinaahi ki Hisu Kristu, eggimuwen din kayi te kanta ka egpakapahale kandin. Egsayeen ta si Hisu Kristu te ware egtamanan. Malehet iya!

20 God who is the source of peace/well-being brought_to_life our(incl) Lord Jesus. He's like a strong guarder of sheep, and by_means of his blood, he confirmed the eternal agreement. 21 (May) God be the one to give you(pl) all good_(things) that you(pl) need for obeying his will. And by_means of Jesus Christ, he will_do to us(incl) what pleases him. We(incl) will_praise Jesus Christ without ending. True indeed!

22 Me suled ku, eghangyuen ku sikaniyu ne eg-ayad-ayad egpammineg te intambag ku kaniyu, su malepet de seini se sulat ku kaniyu. 23 Igkeupii ku ne egpakataha kew ne nakalihawang e diye te prisuwan ka suled ta ne si Timutiyu. Ke mahaan de egpekeuma sikandin kayi, egdumeen ku sikandin te eggendue te kaniyu.

22 My siblings, I request/plead_with you(pl) to carefully listen to my advice to you(pl), for this letter of mine to you(pl) is short. 23 I want you(pl) to know that our(incl) sibling Timutiyu has already left prison. If he is_able_to_arrive here soon, I will_get_ him _to_accompany me to go_there to you(pl).

24 Ipangemuste e re te langun ne me pangulu niyu wey te langun ne keet-etawan te Manama. Migpangemusta degma kaniyu ka me suled ta ne matig-Italya.

24 I greet all of your(pl) leaders and all the people of God. Our(incl) siblings from_Italy also greet you(pl).

25 Ka keupiya wey keyid-u ne egpuun te Manama, egkaangken niyu langun.

25 (May) the goodness and mercy from God, be received by you(pl) all.
